copy.descriptionZh: 朱丽安·摩尔饰演一位寡妇，直面她知名丈夫令人毛骨悚然的过去。

copy.descriptionEn: Amy Adams astounds in a story of language, loss, and extraterrestrial encounters.
copy.descriptionZh: 艾米·亚当斯在语言、失落与外星接触的故事中表现惊艳。

copy.descriptionEn: Steven Spielberg’s futuristic thriller is a masterclass in style and suspense.
copy.descriptionZh: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的这部未来主义惊悚片堪称风格与悬念的典范。

copy.descriptionEn: Jon Hamm stars in the irresistible hit about affairs, money, and murder.
copy.descriptionZh: 乔恩·哈姆主演这部关于婚外情、金钱和谋杀的引人入胜的热门作品。

copy.descriptionEn: It’s been 11 years since his daughter went missing. One phone call could lead him to her.
copy.descriptionZh: 距离他的女儿失踪已经过去11年了。一个电话或许能带他找到她。

copy.descriptionEn: A desperate stepmother must piece together the puzzle of her husband’s sudden disappearance.
copy.descriptionZh: 一位走投无路的继母必须拼凑出她丈夫突然失踪的谜团。

copy.descriptionEn: Colin Farrell is a private eye navigating the dark corners of sunny LA, haunted by a secret too dangerous to expose.
copy.descriptionZh: 科林·法瑞尔饰演一名私家侦探，在阳光普照的洛杉矶的黑暗角落中穿行，被一个过于危险而不能曝光的秘密所困扰。

copy.descriptionEn: Vince Vaughn finds trouble on the shady side of paradise.
copy.descriptionZh: 文斯·沃恩在天堂的阴暗面惹上了麻烦。

copy.descriptionEn: From Martin Scorsese and Steven Spielberg. A convict walks free and back into the life of the lawyer who put him in jail.
copy.descriptionZh: 来自马丁·斯科塞斯和史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格。一名罪犯重获自由，并回到了把他送进监狱的律师的生活中。

copy.descriptionEn: Jake Gyllenhaal is a married prosecutor suspected of murder.
copy.descriptionZh: 杰克·吉伦哈尔饰演一名被怀疑谋杀的已婚检察官。

copy.descriptionEn: An expert negotiator is in for the ride of his life—and so is everyone on board with him.
copy.descriptionZh: 一位专家谈判专家将迎来他人生中最刺激的一程——船上（或车上/机上）的每个人也是如此。

copy.descriptionEn: A shocking crime saga inspired by actual events.
copy.descriptionZh: 一部受真实事件启发而创作的令人震惊的犯罪传奇。

copy.descriptionEn: Tight-knit sisters are investigated for their toxic brother-in-law’s death.
copy.descriptionZh: 关系紧密的姐妹因她们那个有毒的姐夫（或妹夫）之死而受到调查。

copy.descriptionEn: Join a historic quest to reach the peak of Mount Everest. Based on an extraordinary true story.
copy.descriptionZh: 加入登顶珠穆朗玛峰的历史性探险。改编自一段非凡的真实故事。

copy.descriptionEn: John Cena’s reunion with his childhood friends takes a wild turn into a globetrotting adventure to save the world.
copy.descriptionZh: 约翰·塞纳（John Cena）与童年好友的重聚急转直下，变成了一场环游世界的拯救世界冒险。

copy.descriptionEn: Witness the true story of the deadliest race in mountaineering history, where you either reach the summit or lose everything.
copy.descriptionZh: 见证登山史上最致命赛事的真实故事，在那里你要么登顶，要么失去一切。

copy.descriptionEn: Trapped behind enemy lines, a U.S. Navy pilot must trust an ex-KGB agent to escape Cold War Russia.
copy.descriptionZh: 一名美国海军飞行员被困在敌后，必须信任一名克格勃前特工才能逃离冷战时期的俄罗斯。

copy.descriptionEn: Dusty “The Hammer” Boyd, a washed-up tennis pro, chases redemption by doing the unthinkable: playing pickleball.
copy.descriptionZh: 过气的网球名将达斯蒂“重锤”博伊德通过做一件不可思议的事来寻求救赎：打匹克球。

copy.descriptionEn: Keanu Reeves stars as a Hollywood icon being blackmailed over a mysterious video.
copy.descriptionZh: 基努·里维斯饰演一位因神秘视频而被勒索的好莱坞偶像。

copy.descriptionEn: Do you believe in love after life?
copy.descriptionZh: 你相信死后有爱吗？

copy.descriptionEn: Mark Wahlberg’s assassin past threatens to derail his family’s holiday vacation.
copy.descriptionZh: 马克·沃尔伯格过去的杀手生涯威胁到了他家人的度假。

copy.descriptionEn: In this powerful love story, two poets face an uncertain future with hope, strength, and unexpected laughter.
copy.descriptionZh: 在这部感人的爱情故事中，两位诗人生动地面对着充满希望、力量和意外欢笑的不确定未来。

zh.summary: 一名转行为南佛罗里达州餐馆检查员的侦探被卷入一个充满贪婪和腐败的世界。没错，里面还有一只猴子。
zh.summary_original: A detective turned restaurant inspector in Southern Florida is pulled into a world of greed and corruption. And yes, there's a monkey.

zh.summary: 杰森·苏戴奇斯饰演泰德·拉索，一名美国橄榄球教练，尽管毫无经验，却被聘去管理一支英国足球队。但他缺乏专业知识的地方，用乐观、逆境中的决心……以及饼干来弥补。
zh.summary_original: Jason Sudeikis is Ted Lasso, an American football coach hired to manage a British soccer team—despite having no experience. But what he lacks in knowledge, he makes up for with optimism, underdog determination...and biscuits.

zh.summary: 这部机智敏锐的间谍剧讲述了一个由军情五处失意特工组成的团队，以及他们讨人厌的老板、臭名昭著的杰克逊·兰姆（加里·奥德曼饰），如何在间谍世界的迷雾中穿梭，保卫英格兰免受邪恶势力的侵害。
zh.summary_original: This quick-witted spy drama follows a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents—and their obnoxious boss, the notorious Jackson Lamb (Gary Oldman)—as they navigate the espionage world’s smoke and mirrors to defend England from sinister forces.

zh.summary: 好莱坞演员马修·麦康纳和伍迪·哈里森多年来一直是挚友，但一个惊人的家庭秘密表明，他们的联系可能比想象的更近。
zh.summary_original: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years—but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

detailMetadata.summary: 厌倦了费城街头残酷生活的退役军人兼警探Jonah Lynn（列维·施瑞博尔 饰），搬到宾夕法尼亚州西部的小镇寻求平静生活。然而，当臭名昭著且本应被关押的连环杀手Jurek Walter（斯蒂芬·格拉汉姆 饰）再次对他的家庭和当地小镇发动袭击时，Jonah必须保护挚爱的人，并被迫将FBI探员Saga Bauer（莎姬·贝兹 饰）推向风口浪尖，与杀手展开生死较量。 该剧改编自Lars Kepler的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。
detailMetadata.title: 夜曲

detailSeasons.summary: 厌倦了费城街头残酷生活的退役军人兼警探Jonah Lynn（列维·施瑞博尔 饰），搬到宾夕法尼亚州西部的小镇寻求平静生活。然而，当臭名昭著且本应被关押的连环杀手Jurek Walter（斯蒂芬·格拉汉姆 饰）再次对他的家庭和当地小镇发动袭击时，Jonah必须保护挚爱的人，并被迫将FBI探员Saga Bauer（莎姬·贝兹 饰）推向风口浪尖，与杀手展开生死较量。 该剧改编自Lars Kepler的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。

zh.summary: 当连环杀手尤雷克·瓦尔特的受害者活着出现时，侦探约拿·林恩竞相寻找仍然失踪的那个人，而他的门徒萨加·鲍尔则潜入暗中，直接从杀手本人那里寻找答案。改编自拉尔斯·开普勒的畅销小说。
zh.summary_original: When a victim of serial killer Jurek Walter turns up alive, detective Jonah Lynn races to find the one person still missing, while his protégé Saga Bauer goes undercover for answers from the killer himself. Based on the bestselling novel by Lars Kepler.

zh.summary: 一个新英格兰城镇的市长决心将其打造成下一个旅游热点，尽管当地人警告说那里受到了诅咒。
zh.summary_original: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it’s cursed.

zh.summary: 在一个满目疮痍且充满毒气的未来，数千人生活在地底深处的巨大筒仓中。在治安官打破一条核心规则且居民神秘死亡后，工程师朱丽叶（丽贝卡·弗格森饰）开始揭开关于筒仓的惊人秘密与真相。
zh.summary_original: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette (Rebecca Ferguson) starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

zh.summary: 一场劫案需要12个月来策划、12小时来执行，而在12天内未被抓住的小偷将永远不会落网。在三个扣人心弦的时间线上，一名联邦调查局特工与一名职业罪犯在欧洲展开了一场致命的猫鼠游戏。
zh.summary_original: A heist takes 12 months to plan, 12 hours to execute—and a thief not caught within 12 days won’t be caught at all. Across three pulse-pounding timelines, an FBI agent and a career criminal face off in a deadly game of cat and mouse through Europe.

zh.summary: 改编自真实故事。朱迪·赫曼性格坚毅、不屈不挠，不再甘愿被当作累赘对待，她将自己的愤怒化为一场革命。1977年，她与100多名残疾人权利抗议者发出响亮的呼声：是体制出了问题——而不是我们。
zh.summary_original: Based on a true story. Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

zh.summary_original: Jake is an injured Navy SEAL who becomes a mentor for his shy, struggling nephew Marc. Using the principles of his military training, Jake teaches Marc how to be a Warrior Kid as he enters high school.

zh.summary: 一名声名狼藉的超级黑客与一名剃刀女孩刺客被招募，去执行一项高风险的盗窃任务，目标是一个拥有无尽财富的强大企业豪门，以及他们为了保护而宁愿杀人的秘密。
zh.summary_original: A disgraced superhacker and a razorgirl assassin are recruited for a high-stakes heist targeting a powerful corporate dynasty with untold wealth…and secrets they’d kill to protect.

zh.summary: 20年来，Felix Carmichael 一直是英国最令人闻风丧胆的犯罪帝国的不可触碰的领袖。但当内部的背叛导致他入狱时，Felix 将不惜一切代价来复仇并夺回他的王座。
zh.summary_original: For 20 years, Felix Carmichael has been the untouchable leader of Britain's most feared criminal empire. But when a betrayal within his ranks leads to incarceration, Felix will risk everything to exact revenge and reclaim his throne.

detailMetadata.summary: Didi和Ren，曾经被誉为天才儿童的两人如今已年过三十，他们开始重新审视自九岁起便维系着的这段关系。从伦敦到东京，途经弗吉尼亚，这部风格独特的浪漫喜剧探讨了潜力、抱负以及长期关系中普遍存在的复杂性。他们开始质疑自己平淡无奇的生活是否兑现了童年的非凡承诺，却发现自己陷入了一种崭新又令人恐惧的混乱之中。

zh.summary: 迪迪和雷恩从九岁起作为天才儿童便一直在一起。如今他们已三十出头并订婚准备结婚，开始怀疑自己是否选择了一种平庸的生活与爱情。
zh.summary_original: Didi and Ren have been together since they were nine-year-old geniuses. Now in their early thirties and engaged to be married, they begin to wonder if they’ve settled for a life—and love—that’s less than extraordinary.

zh.summary: 兄妹 Karl、Addy 和 Michael 有一个非常特别的隔壁邻居：一只名叫 Stillwater 的聪明的熊猫。他的友谊和故事为他们提供了看待世界、自己和彼此的新视角。
zh.summary_original: Siblings Karl, Addy, and Michael have a very special next-door neighbor: a wise panda named Stillwater. His friendship and stories give them new perspectives on the world, themselves, and each other.
zh.title: 静水

zh.summary: 改编自阿诺德·洛贝尔广受喜爱的图书系列。青蛙和蟾蜍一点也不像。青蛙喜欢新的冒险。蟾蜍喜欢家的舒适。然而尽管存在种种不同，青蛙和蟾蜍总是彼此陪伴——正如最好的朋友应该做的那样。
zh.summary_original: Based on the beloved book series by Arnold Lobel. Frog and Toad are not at all alike. Frog likes new adventures. Toad likes the comforts of home. Yet despite their differences, Frog and Toad are always there for each other—as best friends should be.
zh.title: 青蛙与蟾蜍

zh.summary: 欢迎来到朗山奶牛场，这里是拖拉机奥蒂斯和他的所有朋友们的家园。奥蒂斯虽然个头小，但心地善良。每当他看到有朋友需要帮助，他就会踩下刹车查看情况，并迅速行动起来提供帮助。
zh.summary_original: Welcome to Long Hill Dairy Farm, home to Otis the tractor and all his friends. Otis may be little, but he has a big heart. Whenever he sees a friend in need, he hits the brakes to see what’s wrong and rolls into action to help.

zh.summary: 来自 Skydance Animation 以及《玩具总动员》和《赛车总动员》背后富有远见的创作者，为您讲述世界上最倒霉的人萨姆·格林菲尔德的故事！萨姆旨在扭转运势的探寻，将她带入了一场前所未见的幸运之地的奇妙冒险。
zh.summary_original: From Skydance Animation and the creative visionary behind Toy Story and Cars comes the tale of Sam Greenfield, the unluckiest person in the world! Sam’s quest to turn her luck around leads to a magical adventure in the never-before-seen Land of Luck.

zh.summary: 在父母神秘失踪一年后，姐妹 Sabrina 和 Daphne 搬到了一个童话成真且每个角落都潜藏秘密的魔法小镇。
zh.summary_original: One year after their parents’ mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.
zh.title: 格林姐妹大冒险

works.en: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock

aliases: Fraggle Rock: Back to the Rock
zh.summary: 吉姆·汉森那些热爱欢乐、音乐的弗吉尔人回来了！加入高博、雷德、温布利、莫基、布伯以及新的弗吉尔朋友们的行列，开启欢闹而壮丽的冒险，领略当我们庆祝并关爱我们相互连接的世界时所发生的奇迹。
zh.summary_original: Jim Henson’s fun-loving, musical Fraggles are back! Join Gobo, Red, Wembley, Mokey, Boober, and new Fraggle friends on hilarious, epic adventures about the magic that happens when we celebrate and care for our interconnected world.
zh.title: 布偶也摇滚

zh.summary: 2021 年奥斯卡®最佳动画长片提名。一名年轻的猎人与父亲一同前往爱尔兰，以协助消灭最后一群狼——但随后她结识了一位来自神秘部落的自由奔放的女孩，传闻该部落的人在夜间会变成狼。
zh.summary_original: 2021 Oscar® nominee: Best Animated Feature. A young hunter journeys to Ireland with her father to help wipe out the last wolf pack—but then she befriends a free-spirited girl from a mysterious tribe rumored to transform into wolves by night.

zh.summary: 威廉·沃尔夫不是普通的男孩。在神奇的“万物工厂”精灵王国里，他是“狼男孩”。通过与新的精灵朋友们的相处，他了解到自己丰富的想象力和无限的创造力拥有改变世界的力量。
zh.summary_original: William Wolfe is no ordinary human boy. Down in the magical spryte realm of the Everything Factory, he’s Wolfboy. And with his new spryte friends, he learns his vivid imagination and limitless creativity have the power to change the world.

zh.summary: 羽毛朋友小鸭和小鹅截然不同，但在一部学龄前儿童节目中，他们学会了如何激发彼此最好的一面。改编自塔德·希尔斯的书籍。
zh.summary_original: Feathered friends Duck and Goose couldn’t be more different, but in this preschool show, they learn how to bring out the best in one another. Based on books by Tad Hills.
zh.title: 小鸭与小鹅

works.summaryEn: Revisit an iconic world of imagination as DJ Lance Rock and friends dance, laugh, and grow with an incredible cast of special guests.

zh.summary: 随着 DJ 兰斯·罗克和朋友们与众多不可思议的特邀嘉宾一起跳舞、欢笑和成长，重温一个标志性的想象力世界。
zh.summary_original: Revisit an iconic world of imagination as DJ Lance Rock and friends dance, laugh, and grow with an incredible cast of special guests.
zh.title: 嘎巴宝宝

zh.summary: 在一个迷人的岛屿上，方形、三角形和圆形在寻求冒险和联系的同时，学习如何应对彼此的差异。改编自麦克·巴内特和乔恩·克拉森的国际畅销书。
zh.summary_original: On a charming island, Square, Triangle, and Circle seek adventure and connection while learning how to navigate each other’s differences. Based on the internationally best-selling books by Mac Barnett and Jon Klassen.

zh.summary: 认识一下普雷策尔，世界上身材最长的腊肠犬，也是五只活泼可爱的小狗贪玩而又支持它们的爸爸。他和妻子格蕾塔一起，鼓励小狗们伸出爪子去解决问题，并在世界上“发出他们的吠声”留下印记。
zh.summary_original: Meet Pretzel, the world’s longest dachshund and a playful, supportive dad to five frisky puppies. Together with his wife, Greta, they encourage their pups to get their paws up to solve problems and “make their bark” on the world.

zh.summary: 加入充满羽毛的趣味冒险，伊娃在树顶社区中寻找历险。每天晚上，她汲取教训、通过写作进行反思，并在力所能及的地方伸出援助之翼。改编自畅销书系 Owl Diaries。
zh.summary_original: Join in on feathery fun as Eva seeks adventure in her treetop community. Each night, she learns lessons, reflects through writing, and lends a helping wing wherever she can. Based on the best-selling book series Owl Diaries.
zh.title: 猫头鹰伊娃

zh.summary: 与天竺鼠Izzy、小兔Zuri以及蛇Tate一起携手展开英勇的冒险——这三个纽约市教室宠物组成的歌剧三重唱，响应着来自世界各地处于困境中的动物们的呼唤。
zh.summary_original: Team up for heroic adventures with Izzy the Guinea Pig, Zuri the Bunny, and Tate the Snake—a trio of opera-singing New York City classroom pets—as they answer calls from animals in need all around the world.

zh.summary: 与 Kammy Kam 和她挚爱的朋友们一起步入一个充满乐趣和想象力的奇幻世界！通过音乐和魔法，他们了解自己的世界并开启无限的惊奇。
zh.summary_original: Step inside a fantastic land of fun and imagination with Kammy Kam and her beloved friends! Through music and magic, they learn about their world and unlock limitless wonder.

zh.summary: 和机灵的兔子莱利一起发挥创意！只需一个纸箱，莱利就能想象出充满新朋友和奇妙冒险的魔法世界。改编自安托瓦内特·波蒂斯屡获殊荣的畅销书系列。
zh.summary_original: Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds full of new friends and fantastic adventures. Based on the award-winning book series by Antoinette Portis.

zh.summary: 欢迎来到 Sagoville，哈维在这里喜欢玩耍并寻找带来傻气乐趣的方法！通过充满创意的冒险和令人难忘的歌曲，他和最亲密的朋友们一起探索、想象，并对大大小小的事物表达由衷的谢意。
zh.summary_original: Welcome to Sagoville, where Harvey loves to play and discover ways to have silly fun! He and his closest friends explore, imagine, and express true thankfulness for all things, big and small, through creative adventures and unforgettable songs.

zh.summary: 在这部吉姆·汉森公司出品、将 Slumberkins 的情感学习搬上银幕的剧集中，与大脚怪、独角兽、树懒、牦牛和狐狸一起踏上冒险之旅，探索情感的世界。
zh.summary_original: Embark on adventures with Bigfoot, Unicorn, Sloth, Yak, and Fox as they explore a world of feelings in this Jim Henson Company series that brings the emotional learning of Slumberkins to life.

zh.summary: 查尔斯·彼得森和莉兹·彼得森找到了培养他们对狗狗的爱意的完美方式——字面意思。这对兄妹承担了照顾幼犬并为它们寻找永远的家的艰巨而又回报丰厚的任务。随着每一只新幼犬的到来，新的冒险开始了。
zh.summary_original: Charles and Lizzie Peterson have found the perfect way to foster their love of dogs—literally. The siblings take on the tough but rewarding task of fostering puppies and finding their forever homes. With every new pup, a new adventure begins.
zh.title: 狗狗天地

zh.summary: 小红鸡派珀是一位颇具潜力的作家，她利用丰富的想象力重写故事，纵身跃入剧情中创造难忘的冒险。改编自大卫·埃兹拉·斯坦的畅销获奖儿童绘本系列。
zh.summary_original: Little red chicken Piper is a budding writer who uses her big imagination to rewrite stories, jumping into the action to create unforgettable adventures. Based on David Ezra Stein’s best-selling, award-winning children’s book series.

zh.summary: 坐落在薰衣草田中的是一个可爱的小农场，姐妹吉尔和杰基在那里培育和关爱她们所有的动物——包括会说话的动物。做一个年轻的农夫并不容易，但每一天都带来冒险和成长的机会。
zh.summary_original: Nestled in lavender fields is a lovely little farm where sisters Jill and Jacky nurture and love all their animals—including the talking ones. Being a young farmer isn’t easy, but every day brings adventure and a chance to grow.
zh.title: 可爱的小农场

zh.summary: 道格是一个年轻的机器人，他感觉生活不仅仅只有冰冷的事实。当其他机器人在插电进行每日下载时，道格拔掉电源，与他的好朋友艾玛一起走进人类世界，去亲身体验其中的奇妙。
zh.summary_original: Doug is a young robot who senses there’s more to life than just the facts. While other robots plug in for their daily download, Doug unplugs and journeys into the human world with his best friend Emma to experience its wonders firsthand.

zh.summary: 认识科迪和“帮手怪”，这是一支热爱解决问题的充满活力的怪兽小队。无论是策划派对、爬山还是精通魔术，“帮手怪”都能想出办法——因为一切都始于一个计划。
zh.summary_original: Meet Cody and the Helpsters, a team of vibrant monsters who love to solve problems. Whether it’s planning a party, climbing a mountain, or mastering a magic trick, the Helpsters can figure anything out—because everything starts with a plan.

zh.summary: 杰克是克洛弗格罗夫最体贴、最关心他人的居民之一，总是以善良和幽默迎接每一个人。他传播同情心、创造力和想象力的能力，激励着镇上的每个人也这样做。
zh.summary_original: Jack is one of Clover Grove’s most thoughtful and caring residents, greeting everyone with kindness and humor. His ability to spread compassion, creativity, and imagination inspires everyone in town to do the same.

works.en: The First Snow of Fraggle Rock

zh.summary: 当假期充满意想不到的冒险与挑战时，弗吉尔们学会了珍惜每一天的独特与特殊，就像雪花一样。
zh.summary_original: When the holidays are filled with unexpected adventures and challenges, the Fraggles learn to appreciate each day for being unique and special, like a snowflake.

works.en: Here We Are: Notes for Living on Planet Earth

zh.summary: 在地球日的前夕，一个早熟的七岁男孩从父母以及那个名字贴切的“万物博物馆”里的一个神秘展览中，了解到了这个星球的奇妙之处。本片改编自奥利弗·杰弗斯的畅销儿童书。
zh.summary_original: On the eve of Earth Day, a precocious seven-year-old learns about the wonders of the planet from his parents—and a mysterious exhibit at the aptly named Museum of Everything. Based on the best-selling children's book by Oliver Jeffers.

zh.summary: 脆莓人或许分散在不同的洞穴里，但他们依然能找到一起享受乐趣的方法！与高宝、雷德、布伯、莫基、温布利和旅行马特叔叔一起聆听故事和歌曲，它们向所有人展示了我们是如何紧密相连的。
zh.summary_original: The Fraggles might be apart in separate caves, but they can still find ways to have fun together! Join Gobo, Red, Boober, Mokey, Wembley, and Uncle Travelling Matt for stories and songs that show everyone how we're all connected.
zh.title: 布偶奇遇记：继续前进

works.summaryEn: Cody is a helpful monster who knows that everything starts with a plan. But sometimes things change and you have to make a new one! Broadcasting from the Helpsters shop, Cody shares creative ideas for what to do when life doesn't go as expected.

zh.summary: 科迪是一个乐于助人的小怪兽，他深知一切都始于一个计划。但有时情况会发生变化，你必须制定一个新计划！科迪从“小帮手”商店进行广播，为生活不如意时该做什么分享富有创意的想法。
zh.summary_original: Cody is a helpful monster who knows that everything starts with a plan. But sometimes things change and you have to make a new one! Broadcasting from the Helpsters shop, Cody shares creative ideas for what to do when life doesn't go as expected.

zh.summary: 为了传播善良，热爱快乐的露露踏上了毕生难忘的冒险之旅，背后支撑她的是新朋友、勇气和动听的歌曲！
zh.summary_original: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!

works.en: It’s the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
works.summaryEn: Costumes, candy, this classic special—some things just scream Halloween. Join the Peanuts gang for a timeless adventure as Charlie Brown preps for a party, Snoopy sets his sights on the Red Baron, and Linus patiently awaits a pumpkin patch miracle.

aliases: 这是南瓜大王哦！查理·布朗！
这是南瓜大王哦查理·布朗
这是个大南瓜哦！查理·布朗！
史努比卡通：万圣节南瓜头
It’s the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
zh.summary: 服装、糖果、这部经典特辑——有些事物生动诠释了万圣节。加入花生漫画伙伴们的行列，开启一场永恒的冒险：查理·布朗筹备派对，史努比将目标对准红色男爵，莱纳斯则耐心等待南瓜地的奇迹。
zh.summary_original: Costumes, candy, this classic special—some things just scream Halloween. Join the Peanuts gang for a timeless adventure as Charlie Brown preps for a party, Snoopy sets his sights on the Red Baron, and Linus patiently awaits a pumpkin patch miracle.
zh.title: 这是南瓜大王哦！查理·布朗！

zh.summary: 世界上最具标志性的狗狗已经准备好特写镜头了。与这只快乐起舞、高飞远走、心怀大志的小猎犬一起开启新的冒险，他的身边还有最好的朋友伍德斯托克和花生漫画的其他伙伴们。
zh.summary_original: The world’s most iconic dog is ready for his close-up. Dive into new adventures with the happy-dancing, high-flying, big-dreaming beagle, who’s joined by best friend Woodstock and the rest of the Peanuts gang.

zh.summary: 在发现自己的队伍面临解散的危险后，史努比和小猎犬侦察队出发前往广袤的户外去赢取徽章。与此同时，查理·布朗和朋友们在斯普林湖营地享受他们的夏天。
zh.summary_original: After discovering their troop is in danger of disbanding, Snoopy and the Beagle Scouts set off to the great outdoors to earn their badges. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown and friends enjoy their summer at Camp Spring Lake.

works.summaryEn: The gang’s all here! Experience the nostalgia and joy of these iconic specials going back more than 50 years. Tag along with Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus, Lucy, and their pals for the early days of their antics and adventures.

zh.summary: 这帮伙伴都到齐了！体验这些历经 50 多年的标志性特别节目的怀旧与欢乐。跟随查理·布朗、史努比、莱纳斯、露西以及他们的朋友们，一起回顾他们恶作剧和冒险的早期岁月。
zh.summary_original: The gang’s all here! Experience the nostalgia and joy of these iconic specials going back more than 50 years. Tag along with Charlie Brown, Snoopy, Linus, Lucy, and their pals for the early days of their antics and adventures.

works.summaryEn: Feeling down about the commercialism of Christmas, Charlie Brown becomes the director of the gang's holiday play. Can he overcome his friends’ preference for dancing over acting, find the “perfect” tree, and discover the true meaning of Christmas?

zh.summary: 对圣诞节的商业化感到沮丧，查理·布朗成为了伙伴们的节日话剧的导演。他能否克服朋友们喜欢跳舞胜过演戏的倾向，找到“完美”的树，并发现圣诞节的真正含义？
zh.summary_original: Feeling down about the commercialism of Christmas, Charlie Brown becomes the director of the gang's holiday play. Can he overcome his friends’ preference for dancing over acting, find the “perfect” tree, and discover the true meaning of Christmas?
zh.title: 查理·布朗的圣诞节

zh.summary: 与史努比一起冲向新领域：太空！在查理·布朗、伍德斯托克和花生帮其他成员的陪伴下，史努比踏上了星际探索与发现的史诗冒险之旅。
zh.summary_original: Blast off with Snoopy as he takes on a new frontier: space! Joined by Charlie Brown, Woodstock, and the rest of the Peanuts gang, Snoopy embarks on epic adventures of interstellar exploration and discovery.

works.en: The Charlie Brown and Snoopy Show
works.summaryEn: Charlie Brown, Snoopy, and the whole Peanuts gang navigate the small moments—and big feelings—of life in these collections of classic shorts.

aliases: The Charlie Brown and Snoopy Show
zh.summary: 查理·布朗、史努比和整个花生漫画伙伴们在这系列经典短片中，体验生活中的点滴时刻与丰富情感。
zh.summary_original: Charlie Brown, Snoopy, and the whole Peanuts gang navigate the small moments—and big feelings—of life in these collections of classic shorts.
zh.title: 查理·布朗和史努比秀

zh.summary: 伊娃被迫逃离地下的避难所来到地球表面，她发现了一个与她预想完全不同的世界。在穿越危险的地形和未知的文明的旅程中，伊娃试图回答那个终极问题：她是最后的人类吗？
zh.summary_original: Forced to flee her underground sanctuary for Earth’s surface, Eva discovers a world unlike anything she expected. As she journeys across perilous terrain and unknown civilizations, Eva searches to answer the ultimate question: Is she the last human?

works.summaryEn: Hidden behind the baseboard of an inventor’s workshop are caves filled with wonderful creatures. Bound together by magic and music, this land is Jim Henson’s classic Fraggle Rock.

zh.summary: 在一个发明家工作间的踢脚板后面，隐藏着布满奇妙生物的洞穴。这片由魔法和音乐紧密相连的土地，正是吉姆·汉森的经典作品《Fraggle Rock》。
zh.summary_original: Hidden behind the baseboard of an inventor’s workshop are caves filled with wonderful creatures. Bound together by magic and music, this land is Jim Henson’s classic Fraggle Rock.
zh.title: 布偶奇遇记

works.summaryEn: As Christmas draws near, the Peanuts gang are in a tizzy as they prepare to celebrate. Charlie Brown needs money for his crush’s gift. Peppermint Patty’s worried about her book report. And the last thing Sally wants is to mess up her debut in the play.

aliases: 查理·布朗，圣诞节又到了

detailMetadata.summary: “史努比再度圣诞节”是一个电视特辑，根据“花生”系列喜剧改编。自从《史努比的圣诞节》1965年发布后，这是第一部以“花生”为主题的特辑，由各种与圣诞相关的故事线组成。1992年11月在CBS首播之后，这一系列发布了两次视频。
detailMetadata.title: 查理·布朗，圣诞节又到了

detailSeasons.summary: “史努比再度圣诞节”是一个电视特辑，根据“花生”系列喜剧改编。自从《史努比的圣诞节》1965年发布后，这是第一部以“花生”为主题的特辑，由各种与圣诞相关的故事线组成。1992年11月在CBS首播之后，这一系列发布了两次视频。
detailSeasons.title: 查理·布朗，圣诞节又到了

zh.douban_title: 查理·布朗，圣诞节又到了
zh.summary: 随着圣诞节临近，花生漫画伙伴们正忙乱地准备庆祝。查理·布朗需要钱给暗恋对象买礼物；薄荷·帕蒂正担心她的读书报告；而萨莉最不想做的事，就是在戏剧首秀中搞砸。
zh.summary_original: As Christmas draws near, the Peanuts gang are in a tizzy as they prepare to celebrate. Charlie Brown needs money for his crush’s gift. Peppermint Patty’s worried about her book report. And the last thing Sally wants is to mess up her debut in the play.
zh.title: 查理·布朗，圣诞节又到了

works.summaryEn: Snoopy and the gang get front-row seats for groundbreaking American moments like the first aircraft flight, space travel, and the March on Washington.

zh.summary: 史努比和伙伴们得以近距离见证美国历史上的重大时刻，例如人类首次飞机飞行、太空旅行以及向华盛顿进军。
zh.summary_original: Snoopy and the gang get front-row seats for groundbreaking American moments like the first aircraft flight, space travel, and the March on Washington.
zh.title: 这就是美国，查理布朗

zh.summary: 当一只幽灵出没于一家社区书店并将虚构角色释放到现实世界时，一群朋友齐心协力，解开了围绕着幽灵未了心愿的惊险谜团。
zh.summary_original: When a ghost haunts a neighborhood bookstore and starts releasing fictional characters into the real world, a group of friends team up to solve an exciting mystery surrounding the ghost’s unfinished business.

zh.summary: 范德霍文一家是个典型的家庭……除了一个诅咒最近将他们深爱的丈夫和父亲亚历克斯变成了石头。为了拯救他，他的妻子和孩子们踏上了令人毛骨悚然的冒险旅程，以归还由一位祖先偷走的古代文物。
zh.summary_original: The Vanderhouvens are a typical family…except a curse recently turned Alex—their loving husband and father—to stone. In order to save him, his wife and kids set out on spine-tingling adventures to return ancient artifacts stolen by an ancestor.

zh.summary: 直言不讳、永远充满好奇心。这就是简要概括下的11岁女孩哈丽特。但如果她想成为未来的作家哈丽特·M·韦尔施，她就需要了解一切。而要了解一切，她就得监视……所有人。
zh.summary_original: Outspoken and perpetually curious. That’s 11-year-old Harriet in a nutshell. But if she’s going to be Harriet M. Welsch, future writer, she’ll need to know everything. And to know everything means she’ll need to spy…on everyone.

works.en: I Want A Dog For Christmas, Charlie Brown
works.summaryEn: All Rerun wants from Santa is a dog, but his mother won’t let him have one. Spending time with Snoopy provides the perfect pick-me-up. But when Snoopy gets too busy to play with Rerun, they call in a substitute—Snoopy’s brother Spike.

aliases: I Want A Dog For Christmas, Charlie Brown
zh.summary: 莱纳斯（Rerun）向圣诞老人要的唯一礼物是一只狗，但他妈妈不让他养。和史诺比在一起的时光成了绝佳的安慰。但当史诺比忙得没空陪莱纳斯时，他们找来了一个替补——史诺比的弟弟史派克（Spike）。
zh.summary_original: All Rerun wants from Santa is a dog, but his mother won’t let him have one. Spending time with Snoopy provides the perfect pick-me-up. But when Snoopy gets too busy to play with Rerun, they call in a substitute—Snoopy’s brother Spike.
zh.title: 查理布朗的圣诞礼物

works.summaryEn: Celebrate the merriest time of the year with the Peanuts gang. Snoopy, Charlie Brown, Linus, Lucy, and Sally each star in a collection of Christmastime tales from the original Peanuts comic strips.

zh.summary: 与花生漫画帮一起庆祝一年中最快乐的时光。史诺比、查理·布朗、莱纳斯、露西和萨莉分别在取材自原作花生漫画专栏的一系列圣诞故事中担任主角。
zh.summary_original: Celebrate the merriest time of the year with the Peanuts gang. Snoopy, Charlie Brown, Linus, Lucy, and Sally each star in a collection of Christmastime tales from the original Peanuts comic strips.
zh.title: 查理·布朗的圣诞故事

works.en: Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy

detailMetadata.originalTitle: Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy
detailMetadata.title: 史努比特辑：有家真好

detailSeasons.originalTitle: Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy
detailSeasons.title: 史努比特辑：有家真好

zh.summary: 史努比心爱的狗屋失踪了，他试图将它找回，并懂得了是什么让一所房子有了家的感觉。
zh.summary_original: When Snoopy’s beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

zh.summary: 花生漫画伙伴们对去新学校感到紧张，于是露西办起了自己的学校。她很快发现，教学比想象中更艰难——而且改变也是一件好事。
zh.summary_original: The Peanuts gang is nervous about going to a new school, so Lucy starts her own. She soon learns that teaching is tougher than she thought—and that change can be a good thing.

zh.summary: 在得知祖母不会来过圣诞节后，露西决定举办一场终极跨年派对来振作精神。与此同时，查理·布朗试图在午夜钟声敲响之前实现他的一项新年愿望。
zh.summary_original: After finding out her grandmother won’t be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year’s Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.

aliases: 史努比特辑：欢迎回家，富兰克林
zh.summary: 富兰克林刚来到镇上，希望能交到朋友，但他惯用的伎俩在花生帮身上不管用。当肥皂盒车大赛到来时，他确信这是一个给新伙伴留下深刻印象的机会，于是与另一个落单的孩子查理·布朗组成了搭档。
zh.summary_original: Franklin is new to town and hoping to make friends, but his usual tactics don’t work on the Peanuts gang. When the Soap Box Derby arrives, he’s sure it’s a chance to impress new pals and teams up with the only other unpartnered kid: Charlie Brown.
zh.title: 史努比特辑：欢迎回家，富兰克林

zh.summary: 当一个由人类抚养长大的牛头人开始梦见他神话般的过去时，他在兄弟和朋友的帮助下踏上了一场疯狂的冒险，以了解真正的自己。
zh.summary_original: When a minotaur raised by humans starts dreaming of his mythical past, he sets out on a wild adventure—with help from his brother and friends—to understand who he really is.

works.en: The Boy, the Mole, the Fox and the Horse

zh.summary: 2023年奥斯卡®最佳动画短片奖。查理·麦克西的畅销书在这部由 NoneMore 与坏机器人制片公司联合制作的精美动画电影中被搬上银幕。跟随四个朋友在寻找家园的旅程中建立起的奇妙羁绊。
zh.summary_original: 2023 Oscar® winner: Best Animated Short Film. Charlie Mackesy’s bestseller comes to life in this beautifully animated film from NoneMore and Bad Robot Productions. Follow the unlikely bond between four friends on their journey to find home.

works.summaryEn: It's the night of Peppermint Patty’s New Year’s Eve bash, but Charlie Brown has to write a book report about War and Peace. Hoping to join the fun for a special dance with the Little Red-Haired Girl, he tries desperately to finish in time.

zh.summary: 正值薄荷·帕蒂的新年前夜派对之夜，但查理·布朗必须写一篇关于《战争与和平》的读书报告。为了能加入派对与红发小女孩共舞，他拼命想要及时完成报告。
zh.summary_original: It's the night of Peppermint Patty’s New Year’s Eve bash, but Charlie Brown has to write a book report about War and Peace. Hoping to join the fun for a special dance with the Little Red-Haired Girl, he tries desperately to finish in time.
zh.title: 新年快乐，查理布朗

works.en: It's the Easter Beagle, Charlie Brown!
works.summaryEn: Linus is certain that the Easter Beagle will bring eggs for everyone this year, but the rest of the gang is skeptical. Taking matters into their own hands, Peppermint Patty and Marcie try to make Easter eggs, while Lucy throws a private egg hunt.

zh.summary: 莱纳斯坚信复活节小猎犬今年会给每个人带来彩蛋，但其余伙伴对此表示怀疑。薄荷·帕蒂和玛茜决定亲自采取行动尝试制作复活节彩蛋，而露西则举办了一场私人寻蛋活动。
zh.summary_original: Linus is certain that the Easter Beagle will bring eggs for everyone this year, but the rest of the gang is skeptical. Taking matters into their own hands, Peppermint Patty and Marcie try to make Easter eggs, while Lucy throws a private egg hunt.

zh.summary: 在父母离异和最好朋友搬走之间，安布尔·布朗正经历一段艰难时期。但她的艺术、视频日记和新朋友兰迪为安布尔提供了表达情感的发泄口，并让她在周围的爱中找到感激之情。
zh.summary_original: Between her parents’ divorce and best friend moving away, Amber Brown is having a tough time. But her art, video diary, and new friend Brandi provide outlets for Amber to express her feelings and find gratitude in the love that surrounds her.

zh.summary: 查理·布朗和伙伴们前往夏令营，空气中弥漫着音乐与欢乐。初次参加的莎莉不明白这有什么好兴奋的。但当夏令营面临被迫关闭的危机时，他们齐心协力将其拯救，以便更多的孩子能够留下属于自己的特殊回忆。
zh.summary_original: Music and glee fill the air as Charlie Brown and the gang head off to summer camp. First-timer Sally doesn’t get what all the hype is about. But when the camp may be forced to close, they team up to save it so more kids can make their own special memories.

zh.summary: 安静、善良的内向女孩玛西有很多出色的点子，可以帮朋友们实现目标并解决问题。但当世界开始关注她、聚光灯落在她身上时，分享这些想法却成了一种挑战。
zh.summary_original: Quiet, kindhearted introvert Marcie has lots of brilliant ideas to help her friends achieve goals and solve problems. But when the world takes notice and the spotlight lands on her, sharing those ideas becomes a challenge.

zh.summary: 跟随戈尔迪和她最好的朋友们一起，在他们深爱的博伊森贝格小镇掀起波澜。他们共同了解到，与众不同是值得庆祝的事——而且这非常有意思。
zh.summary_original: Follow Goldie as she shakes up her beloved town of Boysenberg with her best friends. Together, they learn that being different is something to celebrate—and it’s a whole lot of fun.

zh.summary: 新学校。新家庭。新超能力。当12岁的本·瓦萨尼发现自己能够变成他遇到的任何人时，对他来说这是一个充满变革的季节。作为一名变形者，本必须弄清楚他是谁以及他想成为谁。
zh.summary_original: New school. New family. New superpower. It’s a season of change for 12-year-old Ben Vasani when he discovers that he can transform into anyone he meets. As a shapeshifter, Ben must figure out who he is and who he wants to be.
zh.title: 我

zh.summary: 凯特·比顿备受喜爱的图书在这部动画剧集中焕发生机。作为一名训练中的勇士，派恩科恩无所畏惧。好在小马总能确保派恩科恩不会自不量力。他们一起了解到，生活可以是一场充满乐趣的冒险。
zh.summary_original: Kate Beaton’s beloved book comes to life in this animated series. As a warrior in training, Pinecone fears no challenge. Thankfully, Pony always makes sure Pinecone never gets in over her head. Together they learn life can be a fun-filled adventure.
zh.title: 松果与小马

works.en: Snoopy Presents: It’s the Small Things, Charlie Brown

aliases: Snoopy Presents: It’s the Small Things, Charlie Brown
zh.summary: 查理·布朗决心赢得这场重要的棒球比赛。但在比赛开始前不久，事情却成了一场惨剧：萨莉与投手丘上的一朵小花结下了不解之缘，并誓死保护它。
zh.summary_original: Charlie Brown is determined to win the big baseball game. But things turn into a fiasco right before the matchup, when Sally bonds with a little flower on the pitcher’s mound and vows to protect it at all costs.
zh.title: 好事一小朵，查理·布朗

zh.summary: 环保新星简是一个9岁的女孩，她的目标是拯救濒危动物。凭借强大的想象力，简带着她最好的朋友大卫和黑猩猩灰胡子踏上了一场场史诗般的冒险，以帮助保护世界各地的野生动物。
zh.summary_original: Budding environmentalist Jane is a 9-year-old on a quest to save endangered animals. Using her powerful imagination, Jane takes her best friends David and Greybeard the chimpanzee on epic adventures to help protect wild animals all around the world.

works.summaryEn: It's Valentine's Day and hearts are fluttering at school. Charlie Brown is waiting for his valentines to start rolling in, while Linus buys a present for his teacher Miss Othmar—which Sally mistakes as a gift from her Sweet Babboo.

aliases: 做我的情人吧，查理·布朗
zh.summary: 情人节到了，学校里的人们心潮澎湃。查理·布朗在等着他的情人节卡片雪片般飞来，而莱纳斯给他的老师奥斯马（Othmar）小姐买了一件礼物——萨莉误以为那是她的“甜心宝贝”送给她的礼物。
zh.summary_original: It's Valentine's Day and hearts are fluttering at school. Charlie Brown is waiting for his valentines to start rolling in, while Linus buys a present for his teacher Miss Othmar—which Sally mistakes as a gift from her Sweet Babboo.
zh.title: 做我的情人吧，查理·布朗

detailMetadata.title: 史努比特辑：将爱献给父母

detailSeasons.title: 史努比特辑：将爱献给父母

zh.summary: 母亲节就要到了，大伙都很兴奋——除了薄荷帕蒂。对她来说，这提醒着她成长过程中没有妈妈陪伴。但好朋友玛茜帮助薄荷帕蒂认识到，家庭有各种各样的形状和大小。
zh.summary_original: Mother’s Day is almost here, and the gang is excited—except Peppermint Patty. For her, it’s a reminder that she didn’t grow up with a mom. But good pal Marcie helps Peppermint Patty see that families come in all shapes and sizes.

zh.summary: 在一个每个人的角色都已注定的城镇里，一位有抱负的创作歌手和她的乐队成员挣脱束缚，去追求梦想，并激励其他人也这样做。
zh.summary_original: In a town where everyone’s roles are predetermined, an aspiring singer-songwriter and her bandmates break free to pursue their dreams and inspire others to do the same.

zh.summary: 改编自备受珍视的经典图书。当七岁的威廉在圣诞节收到一盘最爱的新玩具时，他发现了一位终生的朋友，并开启了一个神奇的世界。
zh.summary_original: Based on the treasured, classic book. When seven-year-old William receives a new favorite toy for Christmas, he discovers a lifelong friend and unlocks a world of magic.

zh.summary: 在这部来自天舞动画（Skydance Animation）的短片中，一名园艺师宇航员坠毁在一颗荒凉的星球上。他遇到了一位飘逸的访客，并发现了构建新生活的快乐——意识到宇宙带来了一些惊人的东西。
zh.summary_original: In this short film from Skydance Animation, a horticulturalist-astronaut crashes onto a desolate planet. He encounters an ethereal visitor and discovers the joy of building a new life—realizing the universe has delivered something astonishing.

works.summaryEn: Warm and fuzzy feelings fill the air as an inspired Snoopy writes poems about Valentine’s Day. Charlie Brown tries to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl. Sally and Lucy hope to get cards from their crushes. Peppermint Patty asks “Chuck” to the dance.

zh.summary: 温暖而美好的感觉弥漫在空气中，灵感迸发的史诺比写下了关于情人节的诗。查理·布朗试图给红发小女孩留下好印象。萨莉和露西希望能收到暗恋对象送的卡片。薄荷·帕蒂邀请“查克”去跳舞。
zh.summary_original: Warm and fuzzy feelings fill the air as an inspired Snoopy writes poems about Valentine’s Day. Charlie Brown tries to impress the Little Red-Haired Girl. Sally and Lucy hope to get cards from their crushes. Peppermint Patty asks “Chuck” to the dance.
zh.title: 查理·布朗的情人节

zh.summary: 乔什·杜宾很高兴能从在家上学转到公立学校，作为唯一一个装有假肢的孩子，他已经准备好迎接挑战。当他在同龄人中开拓属于自己的一席之地时，他的朋友和家人在每一步都陪伴着他。
zh.summary_original: Josh Dubin is thrilled to switch from homeschool to public school, and being the only kid with a prosthetic leg is a challenge he’s ready to face. As he carves out a place among his peers, his friends and family are with him every step of the way.

zh.summary: 对于海滨密友萨姆和杰德来说，敏捷的机智让他们在宁静的家乡冲浪边侦破超自然谜团时有了大胆的发现。改编自畅销青少年图画小说。
zh.summary_original: Quick wits lead to daring discoveries for beachside besties Sam and Jade as they sleuth out supernatural mysteries in their sleepy hometown of Surfside. Based on the best-selling young adult graphic novels.
zh.title: 苏夫塞德女孩

zh.summary: 上学和结交新朋友可能很难。还得胸前挂着笨重的助听器同时做这两件事？那需要超能力！在超级英雄分身“超能迪娃”的帮助下，西西学会了接纳自己的不同。
zh.summary_original: Going to school and making new friends can be tough. Having to do both while wearing a bulky hearing aid on your chest? That takes superpowers! With a little help from her superhero alter ego, El Deafo, Cece learns to embrace her differences.

zh.summary: 在这部科幻选集剧集中，当不久未来的学生们经历神秘事件时，好奇心引发了混乱。
zh.summary_original: In this sci-fi anthology series, curiosity leads to chaos when students in the near future experience mysterious events.

zh.summary: 经历了一次改变人生的经历后，13岁的埃拉渴望抓住每一天。在学会珍惜每一个瞬间的同时，她直面了曾经定义她的恐惧，并鼓励其他人也这样做。
zh.summary_original: After a life-changing experience, 13-year-old Ella is eager to seize the day. As she learns to appreciate each moment, she faces the fears that once defined her—and encourages others to do the same.

works.en: Peanuts in Space: Secrets of Apollo 10
works.summaryEn: To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the moon landing, this documentary tries to solve the great mystery: Was Snoopy a top-secret astronaut? Starring Jeff Goldblum as a self-published NASA historian and Ron Howard as himself, Peanuts in Space takes an affectionate, lighthearted look at NASA and Charles M. Schulz’s beloved Peanuts characters.

aliases: 花生在太空：阿波罗十号的秘密

zh.douban_title: 花生在太空：阿波罗十号的秘密
zh.summary: 为了庆祝登月 50 周年，这部纪录片试图解开这个巨大的谜团：史诺比曾是绝密宇航员吗？由杰夫·高布伦（Jeff Goldblum）饰演一位自费出版的美国宇航局历史学家，朗·霍华德（Ron Howard）本色出演，《太空中的花生》深情而轻松地审视了美国宇航局和查尔斯·M·舒尔茨（Charles M. Schulz）深受喜爱的花生漫画角色。

Starring Jeff Goldblum as a self-published NASA historian and Ron Howard as himself, Peanuts in Space takes an affectionate, lighthearted look at NASA and Charles M. Schulz’s beloved Peanuts characters.
zh.title: 花生在太空：阿波罗十号的秘密

detailMetadata.title: 史前星球：冰川时代

detailSeasons.summary: 这部五集纪录片带领观众进入恐龙灭绝后数百万年的史前新时代——冰川时代。
detailSeasons.title: 史前星球：冰川时代

zh.summary: 在这部由乔恩·费儒和《地球脉动》制作人联手打造的史诗级系列片中，以全新视角体验我们世界的奇观。回到雄伟的恐龙和非凡的生物漫游于陆地、海洋和天空的时代。
zh.summary_original: Experience the wonders of our world like never before in this epic series from Jon Favreau and the producers of Planet Earth. Travel back to a time when majestic dinosaurs and extraordinary creatures roamed the lands, seas, and skies.

zh.summary: 由保罗·路德担任旁白，这部纪录片剧集展示了大自然中鲜为人知的微小英雄。每集聚焦于小型生物及其为生存而采取的非凡举措，充满了令人惊叹的故事和壮丽的摄影。
zh.summary_original: Narrated by Paul Rudd, this docuseries showcases nature's lesser-known tiny heroes. Spotlighting small creatures and the extraordinary things they do to survive, each episode is filled with surprising stories and spectacular cinematography.

zh.summary: 探索动物们应对生活中最非凡挑战的聪明且富有创意的方式，从离开家园到寻找伴侣。由休·博内威利担任旁白。
zh.summary_original: Discover the clever and creative ways animals navigate life’s most extraordinary challenges, from leaving home to finding a partner. Narrated by Hugh Bonneville.

zh.summary: 这部纪录片由汤姆·希德勒斯顿担任旁白，在六大洲拍摄，运用了尖端的摄像技术来捕捉动物的夜间生活，以前所未有的全彩画面揭示了全新的行为。
zh.summary_original: Narrated by Tom Hiddleston and filmed across six continents, this docuseries uses cutting-edge camera technology to capture animals' nocturnal lives, revealing new behaviors filmed in full color like never before.
zh.title: 夜色中的地球

zh.summary: 从冰冷的极地到热带雨林，去结识大自然中最迷人的巨兽，它们证明了体型庞大也伴随着巨大的挑战。由汤姆·希德勒斯顿担任旁白。
zh.summary_original: Travel from freezing poles to tropical rainforests to meet nature’s most captivating giants, who prove being big comes with enormous challenges. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.

detailMetadata.summary: 这部历时数年、跨越三大洲拍摄的六集纪录片，追踪六只濒危幼崽在人类世界成长却终将回归自然的历程。从初生襁褓到踏上荒野征程，聚焦这些生命在生存挑战中展现的坚韧与胜利，既刻画动物自身的生存之道，也展现守护它们的非凡人类。
detailMetadata.title: 生而狂野

detailSeasons.summary: 这部历时数年、跨越三大洲拍摄的六集纪录片，追踪六只濒危幼崽在人类世界成长却终将回归自然的历程。从初生襁褓到踏上荒野征程，聚焦这些生命在生存挑战中展现的坚韧与胜利，既刻画动物自身的生存之道，也展现守护它们的非凡人类。
detailSeasons.title: 生而狂野

zh.summary: 从迈出第一步到第一次狩猎，跟随六只珍稀动物幼崽学习生存技能，为它们物种在野外的未来带来希望。
zh.summary_original: From first steps to first hunts, follow six rare baby animals as they learn survival skills and bring hope for the future of their species in the wild.
zh.title: 生而狂野

zh.summary: 沉浸式音频展现了动物在世界各地交流的意想不到、不为人知且鲜为人知的方式。由汤姆·希德勒斯顿（Tom Hiddleston）担任旁白。
zh.summary_original: Immersive audio reveals the unexpected, unfamiliar, and untold ways in which animals communicate around the world. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.

zh.summary: 由大卫·爱登堡担任旁白，从未公开过的画面展示了我们处于居家隔离状态如何为大自然的恢复和繁荣敞开了大门。跨越海洋、天空和陆地，当人类停下脚步时，地球找到了它的节奏。
zh.summary_original: Narrated by David Attenborough, never-before-seen footage shows how our living in lockdown opened the door for nature to bounce back and thrive. Across the seas, skies, and lands, Earth found its rhythm when we came to a stop.

zh.summary: 在这部电影长片级的纪录片中，开启一段关于家庭、勇气和回归家园的史诗之旅。跟随雄伟的族长雅典娜，它带领着大象族群穿过充满生机野生动物的严酷非洲景观。
zh.summary_original: Embark on an epic journey of family, courage, and coming home in this feature-length documentary. Join Athena, the majestic matriarch, as she leads her elephant herd across an unforgiving African landscape filled with vibrant wildlife.

zh.summary: 在这部烧脑的惊悚片中，杰森·德森被绑架到了他自己人生的另一个平行版本中。为了回到真正的家人身边，德森踏上一段旅程，试图将他们从能想象到的最强大敌人——他自己手中拯救出来。改编自布莱克·克劳奇的畅销书。
zh.summary_original: In this mind-bending thriller, Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his own life. To get back to his real family, Dessen embarks on a journey to save them from the biggest foe imaginable: himself. Based on Blake Crouch’s bestseller.

zh.summary: 马克领导着一个办公室员工团队，他们的记忆经手术被分割为工作和个人生活两部分。当一个神秘的同事在工作之外出现时，一段探索他们工作真相的旅程就此展开。
zh.summary_original: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

zh.summary: 想象一个全球太空竞赛从未结束的世界。这部由罗纳德·D·穆尔（《外乡人》、《太空堡垒卡拉狄加》）带来的惊心动魄的历史“假设”之作，聚焦于NASA宇航员及其家人们高风险的生活。
zh.summary_original: Imagine a world where the global space race never ended. This thrilling “what if” take on history from Ronald D. Moore (Outlander, Battlestar Galactica) spotlights the high-stakes lives of NASA astronauts and their families.

zh.summary: 根据艾萨克·阿西莫夫的获奖小说改编，《基地》记录了一群流亡者在银河帝国衰落之际，为拯救人类和重建文明而踏上的宏伟旅程。
zh.summary_original: Based on the award-winning novels by Isaac Asimov, Foundation chronicles a band of exiles on their monumental journey to save humanity and rebuild civilization amid the fall of the Galactic Empire.

zh.summary: 地球上最痛苦的人必须从幸福中拯救世界。
zh.summary_original: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

zh.summary: 在幸存於哥斯拉对旧金山的袭击之后，凯特再次被一个令人震惊的秘密所震撼。在怪物般的威胁中，她踏上一场环游世界的冒险，以了解关于她自己家庭以及被称为“帝王组织”的神秘组织的真相。
zh.summary_original: After surviving Godzilla’s attack on San Francisco, Cate is shaken yet again by a shocking secret. Amid monstrous threats, she embarks on a globetrotting adventure to learn the truth about her family—and the mysterious organization known as Monarch.

zh.summary: 地球迎来了威胁人类生存的外星物种。故事通过全球五位普通人的视角实时展开，他们在混乱的现实中努力挣扎，试图理解周遭发生的一切。
zh.summary_original: Earth is visited by an alien species that threatens humanity’s existence. Events unfold in real time through the eyes of five ordinary people across the globe as they struggle to make sense of the chaos unraveling around them.

zh.summary: 科林·法瑞尔饰演约翰·苏加尔，一位潇洒的私家侦探，穿梭于阳光灿烂的洛杉矶的黑暗角落。尽管苏加尔只看到人性美好的一面，但他却被一个过于危险而不能曝光的秘密所困扰。
zh.summary_original: Colin Farrell is John Sugar, a dashing private eye navigating the dark corners of sunny LA. Though he sees only the good in humanity, Sugar is haunted by a secret too dangerous to expose.

zh.summary: 在遥远的未来，人类失去了视力。杰森·莫玛饰演一对出生时就拥有神话般的视力能力的双胞胎的父亲，他必须保护自己的部落免受一位心怀威胁的女王的侵害。戴夫·巴蒂斯塔和阿尔法·伍达德也出演了本片。
zh.summary_original: In the far future, humankind has lost its sense of sight. Jason Momoa stars as the father of twins born with the mythic ability to see—who must protect his tribe against a threatened queen. Dave Bautista and Alfre Woodard also star.

zh.summary: 两名经过高度训练的情报人员（迈尔斯·特勒和安雅·泰勒-乔伊饰）被派往一座神秘峡谷的两侧进行警戒，在远距离的相处中逐渐产生情愫。当底下的邪恶力量浮出水面时，他们必须携手合作，才能在其中的危机中生存下来。
zh.summary_original: Two highly trained operatives (Miles Teller and Anya Taylor-Joy) grow close from a distance after being sent to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge. When an evil below emerges, they must work together to survive what lies within.

zh.summary: 走进一个受《为全人类》启发的心跳加速的篇章。同样的架空历史宇宙。不同的视角：苏联的视角。与在登月竞赛中冒着一切危险的宇航员、工程师和情报人员一起，深入铁幕背后。
zh.summary_original: Step into a thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind. Same alt-history universe. Different perspective: the Soviet Union’s. Go behind the Iron Curtain with the cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers who risked it all in the race for the Moon.

zh.summary: 国际空间站发生致命事故后，一名孤独的宇航员踏上了重返地球的英雄之旅，却发现她生活中的关键部分——包括她的小女儿——都发生了改变。
zh.summary_original: When a fatal accident occurs on board the International Space Station, a lone astronaut makes the heroic journey back to Earth, only to discover key pieces of her life—including her young daughter—have changed.

zh.summary: 汤姆·汉克斯饰演芬奇，在一个危险而满目疮痍的世界里，他踏上一段感人且充满力量的旅程，为他异乎寻常的家人——他心爱的狗和新创造的机器人——寻找一个新家。
zh.summary_original: Tom Hanks is Finch, a man who embarks on a moving and powerful journey to find a new home for his unlikely family—his beloved dog and a newly created robot—in a dangerous and ravaged world.

zh.summary: 一名居住在日本京都的美国女性，其生活因丈夫和儿子在一场神秘空难中失踪而发生了翻天覆地的变化。作为慰藉，她得到了“桑尼”，这是她丈夫的电子公司制造的新一代家用机器人之一。
zh.summary_original: The life of an American woman living in Kyoto, Japan, is upended when her husband and son disappear in a mysterious plane crash. As consolation, she’s given Sunny, one of a new class of domestic robots made by her husband’s electronics company.

zh.summary: 通过一系列相互关联的电话对话讲述，这部开创性的剧集记录了一群陌生人的神秘故事，在末日事件发生前夕，他们的生活陷入了混乱。
zh.summary_original: Told through a series of interconnected phone conversations, this groundbreaking series chronicles the mysterious story of a group of strangers whose lives are thrown into disarray in the lead-up to an apocalyptic event.

zh.summary: 在不久的将来，卡梅伦·特纳被诊断出患有绝症。在面对一个旨在保护妻子和儿子免受悲伤之苦的实验性方案时，他在这一部引人深思的关于爱、失落与牺牲的探索中，艰难抉择是否要改变他们的命运。
zh.summary_original: In the near future, Cameron Turner is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Presented with an experimental solution to shield his wife and son from grief, he grapples with altering their fate in this thought-provoking exploration of love, loss, and sacrifice.

zh.summary: 由富有远见的电影制片人金知云执导。才华横溢的脑科学家世元（李善钧饰）遭遇了一场可怕的个人悲剧。为了急切地查明家人遭遇了什么，他与死者进行“脑同步”，以获取他们的记忆来寻找线索。
zh.summary_original: From visionary filmmaker Kim Jee-woon. Brilliant brain scientist Sewon (Lee Sun-kyun) suffers a horrific personal tragedy. Desperate to uncover what happened to his family, he conducts “brain syncs” with the dead to access their memories for clues.

zh.summary: 在一个高科技的未来，一个叛逆的安保机器人（亚历山大·斯卡斯加德饰）秘密获得了自由意志。为了保持隐蔽，它不情愿地加入了一项在危险星球上保护科学家的任务……尽管它其实只想狂刷肥皂剧。
zh.summary_original: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot (Alexander Skarsgård) secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet…even though it just wants to binge soap operas.

works.en: The Last Days of Ptolemy Grey

zh.summary: 托勒密·格雷突然失去了他信任的照顾者，转而由孤女罗宾负责照料。当他们得知有一种治疗方法可以恢复托勒密因痴呆而模糊的记忆时，一段通往惊人真相的旅程就此展开。
zh.summary_original: Suddenly left without his trusted caretaker, Ptolemy Grey is assigned to the care of orphaned teenager Robyn. When they learn about a treatment that will restore Ptolemy’s dementia-addled memories, it begins a journey toward shocking truths.

zh.summary: 安娜和瑞安通过一项充满争议的测试，证明了他们找到了真爱。只有一个问题：安娜仍然不确定。这时，她遇到了阿米尔。
zh.summary_original: Anna and Ryan have found true love together. It’s been proven by a controversial test. There’s just one problem: Anna still isn’t sure. Then she meets Amir.

zh.summary: 在一个复古未来主义的世界里，极具魅力的推销员杰克·比林斯（艾美奖®得主比利·克鲁德普饰）带领着一群销售同事，决心通过兜售月球分时度假房来重振顾客的生活。
zh.summary_original: In a retro-futuristic world, charismatic salesman Jack Billings (Emmy® winner Billy Crudup) leads a team of fellow sales associates determined to revitalize their customers’ lives by hawking timeshares on the moon.

zh.summary: 由富有远见的执行制片人史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格、爱德华·基齐斯和亚当·霍洛维茨共同打造，这部对经典选集剧集的全新演绎将平凡的角色带入奇迹、可能与想象的世界中。
zh.summary_original: From visionary executive producers Steven Spielberg, Edward Kitsis, and Adam Horowitz, this reimagining of the classic anthology series transports everyday characters into worlds of wonder, possibility, and imagination.

zh.summary: 八个相互交织的故事跨越33年展开，探讨了我们星球不断变化的气候将如何影响家庭、工作、信仰以及生存。
zh.summary_original: Eight interconnected stories told over 33 years explore how our planet’s changing climate will affect family, work, faith—and survival.

zh.summary: 体验惊心动魄的高峰和令人心碎的低谷，世界顶级厨师们正追求终极荣誉：米其林星。这些匿名检查员以前从未向任何人透露过他们神秘的方式，直到现在。
zh.summary_original: Experience thrilling highs and crushing lows as the world’s best chefs pursue the ultimate accolade: a Michelin Star. These anonymous inspectors have never let anyone in on their mysterious ways, until now.

zh.summary: 一场争夺冬季首登K2的历史性竞赛演变成了一场悲剧，暴露了野心、自我和对荣耀的追求可能和这座山本身一样危险。
zh.summary_original: A historic race to become the first to summit K2 in winter unravels into tragedy, exposing how ambition, ego, and the pursuit of glory can be as dangerous as the mountain itself.

works.en: The Reluctant Traveler With Eugene Levy

aliases: 尤金·列维的宅老爹旅行
尤金李维的宅老爹旅行
The Reluctant Traveler With Eugene Levy
zh.summary: 获奖演员兼容易紧张的探险家尤金·列维走出自己的舒适区，对世界上最美丽、最迷人的目的地进行了一场旋风般的旅行。
zh.summary_original: Award-winning actor and nervous explorer Eugene Levy steps out of his comfort zone for a whirlwind tour of the world’s most beautiful and intriguing destinations.
zh.title: 尤金·列维的宅老爹旅行

zh.summary: 走进大学篮球史上最具统治力的项目，吉诺·奥里耶马将球员们逼到极限以赢得12个冠军。丽贝卡·洛博、戴安娜·陶乐西、佩奇·布克斯等人揭示了在康涅狄格大学生存并建立王朝所需要付出的一切。
zh.summary_original: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

zh.summary: 探索世界上最具想象力的住宅背后的开创性理念和鼓舞人心的故事。在这部跨越全球的纪录片系列中，结识那些挑战“家”的传统概念并重新思考我们生活方式的远见者。
zh.summary_original: Discover the groundbreaking ideas and inspiring stories behind the world’s most imaginative dwellings. In this globe-spanning docuseries, meet the visionaries who are challenging conventional concepts of “home” and rethinking how we live.

zh.summary: 深入探究该特许经营权20年的历程，从促成六次超级碗胜利的独特化学反应，到引发地盘争夺的内部冲突。汤姆·布雷迪、比尔·贝利奇克、罗伯特·克拉夫特以及关键球员们揭示了通往伟大之路及其付出的代价。
zh.summary_original: Go inside the franchise’s 20-year journey, from the unique chemistry that fueled six Super Bowl wins to the internal strife that sparked a turf war. Tom Brady, Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft, and key players reveal the road to—and cost of—greatness.

works.summaryEn: In Formula 1's 75th year, rookies surge forward and a title-winning team faces turmoil as a three-way contest for the world championship grips the grid.

detailMetadata.summary: Netflix出品的F1纪录片《极速求生》第八季，于2026年2月27日全球上线，全季10集聚焦2025赛季的激烈赛场与围场秘辛。本季不仅呈现了诺里斯以2分分差险胜维斯塔潘拿下生涯首个车手总冠军、迈凯伦卫冕车队冠军的极致争冠大戏，还深度揭秘汉密尔顿加盟法拉利后的磨合困境 、红牛领队霍纳突然离任的车队动荡，以及迈凯伦队内的队友竞争。同时，镜头也捕捉到胡肯伯格拿下惊喜领奖台的温情时刻，更因这是最后一季聚焦地效赛车的内容而颇具纪念意义，依旧以赛道高光画面搭配独家幕后视角，展现F1赛场内外的热血与波澜。

zh.summary: 在一级方程式赛车迎来第 75 个年头之际，新秀们奋起直追，一支曾夺得冠军的车队陷入混乱，一场三方争夺世界冠军的较量正紧紧锁住整个发车区。
zh.summary_original: In Formula 1's 75th year, rookies surge forward and a title-winning team faces turmoil as a three-way contest for the world championship grips the grid.
zh.title: 一级方程式：疾速争胜

zh.summary: 斯蒂芬·库里——篮球史上最具影响力、活力且出人意料的球员之一——从一名身材矮小的大学球员崛起为四次NBA总冠军的非凡成长故事。
zh.summary_original: The remarkable coming-of-age story of Stephen Curry—one of the most influential, dynamic, and unexpected players in basketball history—and his rise from an undersized college player to a four-time NBA champion.

works.en: Messi’s World Cup: The Rise of a Legend

zh.summary: 跟随这位传奇人物历经五届世界杯的史诗般征程，最终在2022年登顶。随着冠军争夺战的展开，梅西分享了对他国家队生涯及所面挑战的一些最私人的感悟。
zh.summary_original: Follow the legend’s epic journey through five World Cups, culminating in 2022’s triumph. As the championship run unfolds, Messi shares some of his most personal reflections—on his national team career and the challenges he’s faced.

zh.summary: 深入职业冲浪世界，看这项运动中最顶尖的选手环游全球，争夺世界冠军头衔。这部纪录片剧集拥有前所未有的拍摄权限，记录了运动员们在巡回赛中的生活，以及他们为登顶所做出的牺牲。
zh.summary_original: Dive into the world of pro surfing as the best in the sport travel the globe to compete for the World Championship title. With unprecedented access, this docuseries captures the athletes’ lives on tour and the sacrifices they make to get to the top.

zh.summary: 与利昂内尔·梅西一起开启他的历史性新篇章——席卷北美和美国职业足球大联盟，与迈阿密国际的队友们共同开创比赛的新时代。
zh.summary_original: Join Lionel Messi as he embarks on his historic next chapter—taking North America and Major League Soccer by storm, and ushering in a new era of the game with his Inter Miami CF teammates.

zh.summary: 前所未有地体验强者之间的对决，洋基队和道奇队重燃了美国职棒大联盟（MLB）最具标志性的季后赛宿敌对决。通过近距离接触超级球星、经理及其家属，见证夺取棒球王座所需要付出的牺牲。
zh.summary_original: Experience the battle of juggernauts like never before as the Yankees and Dodgers revive MLB’s most iconic playoff rivalry. With intimate access to superstar players, managers, and their families, witness the sacrifices it takes to claim baseball’s throne.

zh.summary: 埃尔文·“魔术师”·约翰逊是一位跨越时代的偶像——从卑微的起点到梦之队，再到商业巨头。这部纪录剧集包含对奥巴马总统、拉里·伯德、帕特·莱利等人的采访，记录了一位传奇人物的生活和职业生涯。
zh.summary_original: Earvin “Magic” Johnson is an icon for the ages—from humble beginnings to the Dream Team to business titan. Featuring interviews with President Obama, Larry Bird, Pat Riley, and more, this docuseries charts the life and career of a legend.
zh.title: 魔术师传奇

zh.summary: 踏上球场，走入这支标志性足球队的幕后，回顾他们令人惊叹的 2021–2022 赛季。在狂热球迷的支持下，他们逆势而上，让怀疑者闭嘴。
zh.summary_original: Step onto the field and go behind the scenes with the iconic soccer team for a look at their astonishing 2021–2022 season. Fueled by their fervent fans, they defy the odds and silence the skeptics.
zh.title: 皇家马德里：直到终点

zh.summary: 标志性运动员们揭开了他们触及伟大的关键职业生涯时刻的面纱。这部真人与视觉效果相结合的风格化短片纪录剧集，为那些你以为自己很了解的体育传奇人物带来了新的视角。
zh.summary_original: Iconic athletes pull back the curtain on a pivotal career moment when they touched greatness. A stylized hybrid of live action and visual effects, this short-form docuseries sheds new light on the sports legends you thought you knew.

zh.summary: 深入赛场之外，零距离接触驱动美国职业足球大联盟的球员和个性人物。激动人心的时刻和引人入胜的故事让2024赛季令人难忘，也让我们得以窥见未来。
zh.summary_original: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season—and gave us a glimpse of the future.

works.en: The Long Game: Bigger Than Basketball

zh.summary: 马库尔·梅克曾是备受瞩目的五星级NBA选秀新星，直到一次意想不到的转折将他带到了霍华德大学。这部鼓舞人心的纪录片剧集记录了马库尔的历程，以及他在家人帮助下重写自己故事的决心。
zh.summary_original: Makur Maker was a five-star NBA prospect headed to the Draft—until an unexpected detour led him to Howard University. This inspiring docuseries follows Makur’s journey and his determination to rewrite his story with the help of his family.

works.en: Boom! Boom! The World vs. Boris Becker

aliases: 砰！砰！世界对战鲍里斯·贝克尔
Boom! Boom! The World vs. Boris Becker
zh.summary: 深入剖析网球名将鲍里斯·贝克尔备受争议的生活与职业生涯——其中包含对约翰·麦肯罗、诺瓦克·德约科维奇、比约恩·博格及其他偶像人物的采访。
zh.summary_original: An inside look at the controversial life and career of tennis great Boris Becker—featuring interviews with John McEnroe, Novak Djokovic, Björn Borg, and other icons.
zh.title: 砰！砰！世界对战鲍里斯·贝克尔

works.en: Super League: The War for Football

zh.summary: 当一项另立门户的联赛计划浮出水面时，欧洲足球的过去、现在与未来发生碰撞，使得这项运动中最具权势的领导们不得不捍卫——或颠覆——该运动的传统。
zh.summary_original: The past, present, and future of European football collide when plans for a breakaway league emerge, leaving the game’s most powerful leaders to defend—or upend—the traditions of the sport.

zh.summary: 欢迎来到世界著名的怪兽工厂，这是一所由身穿紧身衣的边缘人群组成的学校，他们在这里逃离日常生活的束缚，追逐成为职业选手的梦想。
zh.summary_original: Welcome to The World Famous Monster Factory, a school where spandex-clad misfits escape the confines of everyday life to chase the dream of going pro.

zh.summary: 与三位专家一起探索地球的隐秘角落，他们正试图拯救六种濒临灭绝的物种。凭借精湛的摄影技术和生存技能，团队争分夺秒地寻找、记录并保护这些神出鬼没的生物，以免为时已晚。
zh.summary_original: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it’s too late.
zh.title: 野性生灵

works.en: The Last of the Sea Women

zh.summary: 在济州岛的海滨，一群坚强的韩国女海女奋力拯救她们正面临威胁而逐渐消失的文化。
zh.summary_original: On the shores of Jeju Island, a fierce group of South Korean divers fight to save their vanishing culture from looming threats.

zh.summary: 两位生物学家展开了一项与其研究对象一样宏伟的事业——破译鲸鱼复杂的交流方式。米歇尔·福内特博士和埃伦·加兰博士前往不同的半球，去揭开一个比我们人类古老数亿年的文化。
zh.summary_original: Two biologists set out on an undertaking as colossal as their subjects—deciphering the complex communication of whales. Dr. Michelle Fournet and Dr. Ellen Garland journey to opposite hemispheres to uncover a culture eons older than our own.

detailMetadata.summary: 深度探访马丁·斯科塞斯丰富多彩的人生，包含他的私人档案，以及与亲友、传奇合作伙伴和这位具有远见的电影大师本人的深度对谈。
detailMetadata.title: 斯科塞斯先生

detailSeasons.summary: 深度探访马丁·斯科塞斯丰富多彩的人生，包含他的私人档案，以及与亲友、传奇合作伙伴和这位具有远见的电影大师本人的深度对谈。
detailSeasons.title: 斯科塞斯先生

zh.summary: 通过对 Martin Scorsese 本人的深入访谈、查阅其私人档案，以及与 Robert De Niro、Leonardo DiCaprio、Margot Robbie、Daniel Day-Lewis、Steven Spielberg 等人的对话，探索他多面的人生。
zh.summary_original: Explore the many lives of Martin Scorsese through intimate interviews with the man himself, access to his private archives, plus conversations with Robert De Niro, Leonardo DiCaprio, Margot Robbie, Daniel Day-Lewis, Steven Spielberg, and more.
zh.title: 斯科塞斯先生

zh.summary: 他们即将讲述一个小故事……迈克·戴蒙德和亚当·霍洛维茨通过由朋友、合作伙伴兼昔日“祖父”级人物斯派克·琼斯执导的现场纪录片体验，分享了他们的乐队故事以及四十年的友谊。
zh.summary_original: Here’s a little story they’re about to tell... Mike Diamond and Adam Horovitz share the story of their band and 40 years of friendship in a live documentary experience directed by friend, collaborator, and their former grandfather, Spike Jonze.

works.en: STILL: A Michael J. Fox Movie

zh.summary: 一个来自加拿大军事基地的个头不高的孩子成为了20世纪80年代国际流行文化宠儿，却发现自己的人生轨迹因一个惊人的诊断结果而改变。当一个不可救药的乐观主义者遭遇不治之症时，会发生什么？
zh.summary_original: A short kid from a Canadian army base becomes the international pop culture darling of the 1980s—only to find the course of his life altered by a stunning diagnosis. What happens when an incurable optimist confronts an incurable disease?

zh.summary: 史蒂夫·马丁是娱乐界最受喜爱且最神秘的人物之一。从过去和现在这两个不同的视角，深入了解他非凡的故事，马丁反思了他的起点是如何引领他走向今天意想不到的充实生活的。
zh.summary_original: Steve Martin is one of the most beloved and enigmatic figures in entertainment. Dive into his extraordinary story from two distinct points of view—past and present—as Martin reflects on how his beginnings led to his unexpectedly fulfilling life today.
zh.title: 史蒂夫

zh.summary: 本·斯蒂勒讲述了其父母——喜剧偶像杰瑞·斯蒂勒与安妮·米拉的故事，探讨了他们对流行文化以及家庭生活的影响，在这里，创造力、家庭、生活与艺术的界限常常模糊不清。
zh.summary_original: Ben Stiller tells the story of his parents—comedy icons Jerry Stiller and Anne Meara—exploring their impact on popular culture and at home, where the lines between creativity, family, life, and art often blurred.

works.en: Come See Me in the Good Light

aliases: Come See Me in the Good Light

detailMetadata.originalTitle: Come See Me in the Good Light
detailMetadata.summary: 这部纪录片由编剧、喜剧人泰格·诺塔洛（Tig Notaro）、著名歌手布兰迪·卡莉（Brandi Carlile）等担当监制，讲述两位才华横溢的诗人，安德烈亚·吉布森和梅根·法利的故事。“在最美的光影中，在电闪雷鸣的瞬间，我的爱人伴我左右。”吉布森在 ta 的诗作 Good Light 中这样写道。通过本片，诗人邀请我们一同见证 ta 对生命、爱与死亡的深刻思考。面对生命的有限，两人用诗歌和爱，书写了一曲动人的生命乐章。
detailMetadata.title: 向光而行

detailSeasons.originalTitle: Come See Me in the Good Light
detailSeasons.summary: 这部纪录片由编剧、喜剧人泰格·诺塔洛（Tig Notaro）、著名歌手布兰迪·卡莉（Brandi Carlile）等担当监制，讲述两位才华横溢的诗人，安德烈亚·吉布森和梅根·法利的故事。“在最美的光影中，在电闪雷鸣的瞬间，我的爱人伴我左右。”吉布森在 ta 的诗作 Good Light 中这样写道。通过本片，诗人邀请我们一同见证 ta 对生命、爱与死亡的深刻思考。面对生命的有限，两人用诗歌和爱，书写了一曲动人的生命乐章。
detailSeasons.title: 向光而行

zh.summary: 在面对失去时的爱与欢乐的亲密故事中，著名诗人 Andrea Gibson 和 Megan Falley 在她们可能共同度过的最后一年中找到了力量——以及意想不到的欢乐。
zh.summary_original: In an intimate and joyful story of love in the face of loss, celebrated poets Andrea Gibson and Megan Falley find strength—and unexpected hilarity—in what might be their final year together.
zh.title: 向光而行

zh.summary: 经过多年的聚光灯追逐，赛琳娜·戈麦斯（Selena Gomez）取得了难以想象的巨大名气。然而，正当她达到新的巅峰时，一场意料之外的变故将她拉入黑暗。这部风格独特、真实且亲密的纪录片记录了她历时六年重返光明之旅。
zh.summary_original: After years in the limelight, Selena Gomez achieves unimaginable stardom. But just as she reaches a new peak, an unexpected turn pulls her into darkness. This uniquely raw and intimate documentary spans her six-year journey into a new light.

zh.summary: 奥斯卡金像奖®获得者埃罗尔·莫里斯（Errol Morris）揭开了大卫·康威尔（David Cornwell）传奇一生的神秘面纱。他曾是一名间谍，在文学界则以约翰·勒卡雷（John le Carré）之名广为人知。
zh.summary_original: Academy Award® winner Errol Morris pulls back the curtain on the storied life and career of David Cornwell, the former spy known to the literary world as John le Carré.

works.en: Billie Eilish: The World’s A Little Blurry

zh.summary: 深入而私密地了解非凡的青少年比利·埃利什（Billie Eilish）。获奖电影制作人R·J·卡特勒（R.J. Cutler）跟随她在巡演路上、舞台上以及在家中与家人在一起的旅程，而她的首张专辑的创作和录制改变了她的人生。
zh.summary_original: Take a deeply personal look at extraordinary teenager Billie Eilish. Award-winning filmmaker R.J. Cutler follows her journey on the road, onstage, and at home with her family as the writing and recording of her debut album changes her life.

zh.summary: 在20世纪80年代，娜奥米·坎贝尔、辛迪·克劳福德、琳达·伊万戈琳娜和克里斯蒂·特灵顿成为了时尚偶像，随后她们通过团结超越了时尚界。讲述了她们如何掌握自己的力量并塑造随后世界的故事。
zh.summary_original: In the ‘80s, Naomi Campbell, Cindy Crawford, Linda Evangelista, and Christy Turlington became fashion icons—then transcended their industry by uniting. This is the story of how they claimed their power and shaped the world that followed.

zh.summary: 在这部首次讲述其故事的重大纪录片中，领略标志性摇滚乐队的传奇遗产。由托德·海因斯（Todd Haynes）以那个时代的前卫精神执导，这部万花筒般的口述历史将独家采访与令人炫目的档案影像结合在一起。
zh.summary_original: Experience the iconic rock band's legacy in the first major documentary to tell their story. Directed with the era’s avant-garde spirit by Todd Haynes, this kaleidoscopic oral history combines exclusive interviews with dazzling archival footage.

zh.summary: 露皮塔·尼永奥担任旁白，讲述了一部关于Peanuts及其创作者查尔斯·M·舒尔茨的纪录片。众多知名粉丝——包括德鲁·巴里摩尔、凯文·史密斯和阿尔·罗克——分享了它对他们的影响，而一则全新动画故事则展现了查理·布朗踏上一段探寻之旅。
zh.summary_original: Lupita Nyong’o narrates a documentary about Peanuts and its creator, Charles M. Schulz. Famous fans—including Drew Barrymore, Kevin Smith, and Al Roker—share its influence on them, and a new animated story finds Charlie Brown on a quest.

zh.summary: 奥普拉·温弗瑞和哈里王子联手引导关于心理健康的坦诚讨论。本系列节目汇集了来自全球的启迪性故事，让我们有机会寻求真相、理解，以及对未来的全新希望。
zh.summary_original: Oprah Winfrey and Prince Harry join forces to guide honest discussions about mental health. This series features illuminating stories from across the globe, giving us the opportunity to seek truth, understanding, and a newfound hope for the future.

zh.summary: 探索你从未见过的亚伯拉罕·林肯的一面。在这部四集纪录片中，多元的历史学家小组和罕见的档案资料对这位被称为伟大解放者的人物提供了更细致入微的审视。
zh.summary_original: Discover a side of Abraham Lincoln you’ve never seen before. In this four-part docuseries, a diverse panel of historians and rare archival materials offer a more nuanced look into the man dubbed the Great Emancipator.

zh.summary: 从未公开过的个人录音和档案影像从路易斯·阿姆斯特朗自己的视角讲述了他的生平故事。从音乐神童到民权活动家，再到世界知名的艺术家，这部富有启迪性的影片展现了阿姆斯特朗鲜为人知的一面。
zh.summary_original: Never-before-heard personal recordings and archival footage tell the story of Louis Armstrong’s life from his perspective. From musical phenom to civil rights activist to world-renowned artist, this illuminating film shows sides of Armstrong few have seen.

zh.summary: 通过言语、音乐和恶作剧，博诺揭开了塑造他成为儿子、父亲、丈夫、活动家和U2乐队主唱的那些极其个人化经历的面纱。
zh.summary_original: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.
zh.title: 波诺：救赎之路

zh.summary: 作为对 The E Street Band、摇滚乐以及音乐塑造 Bruce Springsteen 人生方式的致敬，这部纪录片记录了 Bruce 在录音室与完整乐队进行自 Born in. U.S.A. 以来的首次现场录音时，对爱与失落的反思。
zh.summary_original: A tribute to The E Street Band, rock ‘n’ roll, and the way music has shaped Bruce Springsteen’s life, this documentary captures Bruce reflecting on love and loss while recording with his full band live in the studio for the first time since Born in the U.S.A.

zh.summary: 一个人的故事可以改变世界。这部由艾美奖获奖电影制作人R·J·卡特勒打造的纪录片剧集，记录了那些改变游戏规则的偶像以及他们所启迪的人们的生活。
zh.summary_original: One person’s story can change the world. From Emmy®-winning filmmaker R.J. Cutler, this docuseries profiles game-changing icons and the people whose lives they’ve inspired.

zh.summary: 这部由制片人奥普拉·温弗瑞打造的揭秘纪录片致敬了传奇人物西德尼·波蒂埃——这位标志性的演员、电影制作人和民权活动家。片中包含对丹泽尔·华盛顿、斯派克·李、芭芭拉·史翠珊等人的采访。
zh.summary_original: From producer Oprah Winfrey, this revealing documentary honors the legendary Sidney Poitier—iconic actor, filmmaker, and civil rights activist. Featuring interviews with Denzel Washington, Spike Lee, Barbra Streisand, and more.

zh.summary: 在一个动荡的时代，1971年是受当时政治和文化剧变推动而充满音乐创新与重生的年份。巨星们达到了新的高度，崭新的才华惊艳登场，边界以前所未有的方式拓展。
zh.summary_original: In a tumultuous era, 1971 was a year of musical innovation and rebirth fueled by the political and cultural upheaval of the time. Stars reached new heights, fresh talent exploded onto the scene, and boundaries expanded like never before.

works.en: Watch the Sound with Mark Ronson

aliases: 与马克·容森探索声音奥秘
Watch the Sound with Mark Ronson
zh.summary: 荣获奥斯卡奖®和格莱美奖®的制作人兼艺术家马克·容森与他的偶像及同行热曲制造者——包括保罗·麦卡特尼、DJ普雷米尔、查莉·XCX、戴夫·格罗尔和奎斯特拉夫——共同探讨了技术与音乐创新的交汇点。
zh.summary_original: Oscar®- and GRAMMY Award®–winning producer and artist Mark Ronson explores the intersection of technology and musical innovation with his heroes and fellow hitmakers—including Paul McCartney, DJ Premier, Charli XCX, Dave Grohl, and Questlove.
zh.title: 与马克·容森探索声音奥秘

zh.summary: 在这部展现来自世界各地艺术家的后台通行证中，浮华与坚韧交织。通过种种考验与胜利，新星们将他们的一切奉献给了一门要求绝对完美的艺术形式。
zh.summary_original: Glitz meets grit in this backstage pass to artists from around the world. Through trials and triumphs, up-and-coming stars give everything they’ve got to an art form that demands nothing less than perfection.
zh.title: 韩国流行音乐偶像

zh.summary: 走近《空战群英》的现实原型飞行员，听他们分享第100轰炸大队经历的惊心动魄与深刻蜕变。由汤姆·汉克斯旁白，史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格参与制作。
zh.summary_original: Meet the real-life airmen who inspired Masters of the Air as they share the harrowing and transformative events of the 100th Bomb Group. Narrated by Tom Hanks and featuring Steven Spielberg.

zh.summary: 这部由导演 Werner Herzog 和 Clive Oppenheimer 带来的非凡旅程横跨我们的星球与宇宙，探索了陨石、流星和深空撞击如何唤醒我们对其他领域的惊叹，并让我们重新思考自己的命运。
zh.summary_original: From directors Werner Herzog and Clive Oppenheimer, this remarkable journey across our planet and universe explores how meteorites, shooting stars, and deep impacts have awoken our wonder about other realms—and make us rethink our destinies.

zh.summary: 在这部对节日寓言的真实生活演绎中，杰里米·莫里斯赋予了圣诞精神全新的意义：他那奢华的节日装饰引发了与邻居的纠纷，最终导致他们集体对簿公堂。
zh.summary_original: In this true-life twist on a holiday fable, Jeremy Morris brings a whole new meaning to Christmas spirit when his extravagant seasonal display sparks a dispute with his neighbors that lands them all in court.

zh.summary: 通过布什总统及其最亲密顾问的视角，体验2001年9月11日发生的事件，他们亲自详细讲述了那个历史性日子里至关重要的时刻与关键决策。
zh.summary_original: Experience the events of September 11, 2001, through the eyes of President Bush and his closest advisors as they personally detail the crucial hours and key decisions from that historic day.

zh.summary: 探索大多数人从未听过的最伟大的民权运动的故事。在1988年世界上唯一一所聋人大学里经历动荡的八天里，四名学生必须找到领导一场革命的方法，并改变历史的进程。
zh.summary_original: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world’s only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.

zh.summary: 这是一部对现代父亲身份的欢乐探索纪录片，汇集了世界各地父亲的证言，从知名喜剧演员到普通父母。他们未经修饰的故事讲述了当今为人父的美好、挣扎和荒诞的滑稽。
zh.summary_original: A joyful exploration of modern fatherhood, this doc gathers the testimonies of dads around the world, from famous comedians to everyday parents. Their unfiltered stories speak to the beauty, struggles, and ridiculous hilarity of being a dad today.

zh.summary: 在塔利班重新掌权之后，一群喀布尔女性为她们的权利和生命展开了一场革命性的斗争。由制片人马拉拉·尤沙夫赛和詹妮弗·劳伦斯倾力打造。
zh.summary_original: In the wake of the Taliban’s return to power, a group of Kabul women lead a revolutionary fight for their rights—and their lives. From producers Malala Yousafzai and Jennifer Lawrence.

zh.summary: 这场对民主核心的喧闹探索捕捉了一个不同寻常的成长仪式：来自德克萨斯州各地的1100名男少年齐聚一堂，从零开始建立一个代议制政府。圣丹斯电影节评审团大奖得主。
zh.summary_original: This raucous journey into the heart of democracy captures an unusual rite of passage: 1,100 teenage boys from across Texas coming together to build a representative government from the ground up. Winner of the Sundance Grand Jury Prize.

zh.summary: 如果美国民主落入十几岁的女孩手中会是什么样子？在这部纪录片中，密苏里州背景迥异的年轻女性领袖们参与了一项沉浸式实验，从头开始建立一个政府。
zh.summary_original: What would American democracy look like in the hands of teenage girls? In this documentary, young female leaders from wildly different backgrounds in Missouri navigate an immersive experiment to build a government from the ground up.

zh.summary: 挚友伊万·麦格雷戈和查理·布鲁曼为第四季的长途跋涉系列做好了准备——这一次他们将从伊万在苏格兰的家出发，前往查理在英格兰的家。当然，他们会选择风景优美的路线，骑着毛病百出的老旧摩托车穿越17个欧洲国家。
zh.summary_original: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan’s home in Scotland to Charley’s in England. They’ll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.
zh.title: 长路归家

works.summaryEn: In 2004, Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman embarked on an epic challenge to bike 20,000 miles across 12 countries and 19 time zones in just 115 days. In the first chapter of the Long Way series, the best friends realized their dream—against all odds.

detailMetadata.summary: 曾主演电影《星际大战》、《红磨坊》的英国男艺人伊旺麦奎格（Ewan Mcgregor）和他的好友 查理布尔曼Charley Boorman 骑着BMW重型机车完成环游世界的壮举，他们从伦敦出发，穿越欧洲、俄罗斯、西伯利亚、哈萨克、蒙古、阿拉斯加，最后回到终点纽约，这趟全程达32000公里的重机长征，共费时115天。

zh.summary: 2004年，伊万·麦格雷戈和查理·布尔曼开启了一项史诗般的挑战：仅用115天骑行20,000英里，穿越12个国家和19个时区。在Long Way系列的第一篇章中，这对挚友克服重重阻碍，实现了他们的梦想。
zh.summary_original: In 2004, Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman embarked on an epic challenge to bike 20,000 miles across 12 countries and 19 time zones in just 115 days. In the first chapter of the Long Way series, the best friends realized their dream—against all odds.
zh.title: 漫漫长路

zh.summary: 史诗般的摩托车冒险在 Long Way 系列的第三篇章中延续，伊万·麦格雷戈和查理·布鲁曼骑着原型电动哈雷戴维森摩托车，穿梭于南美洲和中美洲壮丽的风景中。
zh.summary_original: The epic motorcycle adventure continues in this third chapter of the Long Way series, as Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman journey to glorious landscapes across South and Central America—on the backs of prototype electric Harley-Davidsons.
zh.title: 一路北上

zh.summary: 当一名联邦调查局菜鸟特工在美国赛马界发现一场大规模洗钱行动时，他冒着生命危险试图将罪魁祸首绳之以法：墨西哥最致命的贩毒集团。
zh.summary_original: When a rookie FBI agent uncovers a massive money laundering operation in American horse racing, he risks his life to take down the culprits: Mexico’s deadliest cartel.

works.en: Vietnam: The War That Changed America

aliases: Vietnam: The War That Changed America

detailMetadata.originalTitle: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
detailMetadata.summary: 以原始、亲切的视角审视越战对美国的影响。在西贡沦陷 50 周年即将到来之际，该系列节目通过个人故事，探讨了这场冲突的深远影响以及对社会的持久影响。
detailMetadata.title: 越南：改变美国的战争

detailSeasons.originalTitle: Vietnam: The War That Changed America
detailSeasons.summary: 以原始、亲切的视角审视越战对美国的影响。在西贡沦陷 50 周年即将到来之际，该系列节目通过个人故事，探讨了这场冲突的深远影响以及对社会的持久影响。
detailSeasons.title: 越南：改变美国的战争

zh.summary: 老友重聚、第一人称叙述以及罕见的镜头，描绘了一幅非凡而深邃的画面，展现了经历历史最长战争之一的生活是什么样的。伊桑·霍克担任旁白。
zh.summary_original: The reunion of old friends, first-person accounts, and rarely seen footage paint an extraordinary and deeply profound picture of what it was like to live through one of history’s longest wars. Narrated by Ethan Hawke.
zh.title: 越南：改变美国的战争

zh.summary: 从秘鲁盐田到卢旺达咖啡林，探索并礼赞那些构建了社会、塑造了信仰并永远改变人类历史画卷的食材。由世界知名主厨勒内·雷泽皮担任旁白。
zh.summary_original: From Peruvian salt flats to Rwandan coffee forests, explore and celebrate the ingredients that built societies, shaped beliefs, and forever altered the tapestry of humanity. Narrated by world-renowned chef René Redzepi.
zh.title: 舌尖上的世界

works.summaryEn: Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman return for a second spin in the Long Way series, traveling 15,000 miles from the northernmost tip of Scotland to the southernmost tip of South Africa.

zh.summary: 伊万·麦格雷戈和查理·布尔曼回归Long Way系列的第二段旅程，从苏格兰最北端一路骑行15,000英里至南非最南端。
zh.summary_original: Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman return for a second spin in the Long Way series, traveling 15,000 miles from the northernmost tip of Scotland to the southernmost tip of South Africa.
zh.title: 长路迢迢

zh.summary: 通过在事件展开时屋内录制的原始音频录音，体验世界上最著名的骚灵案件令人毛骨悚然的真实故事。
zh.summary_original: Experience the chilling true story of the world’s most famous poltergeist case through original audio recordings made inside the house as the events unfolded.

zh.summary: 埃里克·C·孔恩曾是一名在肯塔基州东部过着穷奢极欲生活的律师……直到两位举报人发现他是一起价值超过五亿美元的政府欺诈案的核心人物，这也是美国历史上最大的欺诈案之一。而这仅仅是个开始。
zh.summary_original: Eric C. Conn was a lawyer living a little too large in eastern Kentucky…until two whistleblowers realized he was at the center of government fraud worth over half a billion dollars, one of the largest in U.S. history. And that was just the beginning.

detailSeasons.title: 底线

zh.summary: 在隐蔽的现代战争中，正确与错误的界限已经模糊。这部纪录片审视了战争的道德模糊性，具体体现在2018年的一个案件中，当时美国海军海豹突击队的一个排指控其长官埃迪·加拉格尔犯有战争罪。
zh.summary_original: In covert modern warfare, the line between right and wrong has blurred. This docuseries examines the moral ambiguities of war as embodied by the 2018 case in which a U.S. Navy SEAL platoon accused its chief, Eddie Gallagher, of war crimes.

zh.summary: 一个密宗瑜伽学校的前成员们勇敢发声，讲述了他们如何从寻找身心健康与社群归属，变成担心自己加入了一个邪教，并为寻求正义而指控一个自封的大师涉嫌虐待与操纵。
zh.summary_original: Ex-members of a tantric yoga school speak out about how they went from searching for wellness and community to fearing they’d joined a cult, and seeking justice for alleged abuse and manipulation at the hands of a self-styled guru.

detailMetadata.summary: 苹果已经进入了原创影视制作，并在苹果音乐客户端中播出，其最引人关注的原创节目是云集了大牌明星的《顺风车卡拉OK》（Carpool Karaoke）。 这一剧集每一集长度为20分钟，每一集将有一位大牌明星出场，在搭乘顺风车的过程中和司机飙歌。《顺风车卡拉OK》在过去的播出过程中引发轰动，而苹果获得了本季节目的版权。
