detailSeasons.summary: 苹果已经进入了原创影视制作，并在苹果音乐客户端中播出，其最引人关注的原创节目是云集了大牌明星的《顺风车卡拉OK》（Carpool Karaoke）。 这一剧集每一集长度为20分钟，每一集将有一位大牌明星出场，在搭乘顺风车的过程中和司机飙歌。《顺风车卡拉OK》在过去的播出过程中引发轰动，而苹果获得了本季节目的版权。
detailSeasons.title: 拼车K歌秀

zh.summary: 踏上一场众星云集、歌声满载的旅程，名人们共乘一辆车，跟随自己的播放列表一起歌唱，并展开各种冒险。
zh.summary_original: Go on a star-studded, song-filled ride as celebrities share a car, sing along to their personal playlists, and embark on adventures.

zh.summary: 乔恩·斯图尔特带着他标志性的幽默，剖析美国最顽疾难除的问题，试图与身居最高权力层的人士共同寻找解决方案……前提是他们愿意接听他的电话。
zh.summary_original: Wielding his signature humor, Jon Stewart walks through America’s most persistent problems to find solutions with people at the highest levels of power...if they’d only return his calls.

works.en: John Lennon: Murder Without A Trial

zh.summary: 约翰·列农生命中和死讯中的关键人物——包括朋友、医生和调查人员——有史以来第一次分享个人记忆，并揭示了他遇害当晚发生的事情。
zh.summary_original: For the first time, key figures from John Lennon’s life and death—including friends, doctors, and investigators—share personal memories and reveal what happened on the night of his killing.

zh.summary: 一个被称为“骗局女王”的神秘人物一直在好莱坞冒充有权势的女性高管，以改变人生的职业机会为承诺诱捕受害者。一名记者和一名私家侦探开始寻找这场骗局背后的罪魁祸首。
zh.summary_original: A mysterious figure—known as the Con Queen—is impersonating powerful female executives in Hollywood, luring victims with the promise of life-changing career opportunities. A journalist and a private investigator set out to find the culprit behind the scam.
zh.title: 好莱坞诈骗女王

zh.summary: 全球音乐偶像与世界知名的 K-pop 偶像联手进行精彩的歌曲对决。这些艺术家以 K-pop 的风格演绎他们最大的热门歌曲，在争夺终极炫耀权的友谊赛中惊艳全场、大显身手并震撼全场。
zh.summary_original: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.

zh.summary: 这部纪录片由 Olivia Colman 担任旁白，通过全球100多名孩子的视角，记录了儿童从出生到五岁如何学习思考、说话、行动和爱。
zh.summary_original: Narrated by Olivia Colman and told through the eyes of over 100 kids across the globe, this docuseries chronicles how children learn to think, speak, move, and love from birth to age five.

works.en: Wanted: The Escape of Carlos Ghosn

aliases: 追缉汽车大亨：卡洛斯·戈恩
Wanted: The Escape of Carlos Ghosn
zh.summary: 关于由首席执行官沦为逃犯的卡洛斯·戈恩的引人入胜的故事，包括他权倾朝野的统治、令人震惊的逮捕，以及震惊世界的精心策划的逃亡。
zh.summary_original: The riveting story of CEO-turned-fugitive Carlos Ghosn, including his reign of power, shocking arrest, and calculated getaway that stunned the world.
zh.title: 追缉汽车大亨：卡洛斯·戈恩

zh.summary: 奥普拉与当今最杰出的新闻人物、思想领袖以及各领域的顶尖大师进行深入探讨。他们为塑造我们世界的各种议题带来真相与视角，揭示引人入胜的人际连接故事。
zh.summary_original: Oprah leads intimate discussions with today’s foremost newsmakers, thought leaders, and masters of their craft. Bringing truth and perspective to a range of topics shaping our world, they reveal gripping stories of human connection.

aliases: 从暗到明：电视与彩虹史
zh.summary: 在这部五集纪录片中，透过电视的视角探索美国LGBTQ运动的历史。该剧结合了历史档案片段与全新访谈，审视了恐同现象、LGBTQ角色的演变以及在电视世界中出柜的过程。
zh.summary_original: Explore the history of the American LGBTQ movement through the lens of TV in this five-part docuseries. Combining archival footage with new interviews, the series looks at homophobia, the evolution of LGBTQ characters, and coming out in the TV world.
zh.title: 从暗到明：电视与彩虹史

zh.summary: 获得与杰出作家进行坦诚对话的前排席位。每一集都包含一本由奥普拉精心挑选的书籍，以及关于它所揭示的问题的访谈。这是当今世界的读书俱乐部，是一扇通往其他世界的窗户。
zh.summary_original: Get a front row seat for unguarded conversations with incredible authors. Each episode features a book handpicked by Oprah, along with an interview about issues that it brings to light. It’s a book club for today’s world—a window to other worlds.

zh.summary: 瑞茜·威瑟斯彭和凯茜·马斯格雷夫斯携手吉米·艾伦、米奇·盖顿和奥维尔·佩克，在一档全新类型的竞技节目中在全球范围内寻找乡村音乐的下一个巨星。
zh.summary_original: Reese Witherspoon and Kacey Musgraves join Jimmie Allen, Mickey Guyton, and Orville Peck on a global search for country music’s next big star in a new kind of competition series.
zh.title: 我的乡村音乐

zh.summary: 与希拉里·克林顿和切尔西·克林顿一起踏上一段难忘的旅程，她们与世界上一些最大胆、最勇敢的女性展开冒险——从家喻户晓的名人到默默无闻的英雄——她们让我们开怀大笑，并激励我们变得更加勇敢。
zh.summary_original: Take an unforgettable journey with Hillary Clinton and Chelsea Clinton as they go on adventures with some of the world’s boldest and bravest women—from household names to unsung heroes—who make us laugh and inspire us to be more gutsy.
zh.title: 勇敢

works.en: Number One on the Call Sheet

zh.summary: 好莱坞的一些超级巨星倾情揭秘他们走向颠覆性主角的历程。在坦诚的采访中，他们阐述了演艺生涯的高潮与低谷、突破时刻、成功蓝图以及下一代巨大的潜力。
zh.summary_original: Some of Hollywood’s biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation’s huge potential.

zh.summary: 我们如何在经历危机时保持正念，同时坚守自我和人性？在本系列中，奥普拉与专家及普通民众进行远程对话，为人类精神提供洞察、意义和切实可行的建议。
zh.summary_original: How can we mindfully move through a crisis while holding on to ourselves and our humanity? In this series, Oprah has remote conversations with experts and everyday people to provide insight, meaning, and tangible advice for the human spirit.
zh.title: 奥普拉谈新冠

zh.summary: 当一群儿时好友重新联系时，他们的聚会发生了疯狂的转变，因为他们偶然发现了一个危险的国际阴谋，并必须拯救世界。
zh.summary_original: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

zh.summary: 改编自一个非凡的真实故事。一个意志坚定的男人踏上一场高风险的探寻之旅，并打破看似不可能的险境，以实现他成为第一个登上珠穆朗玛峰顶峰的人的梦想。
zh.summary_original: Based on an extraordinary true story. A determined man embarks on a high-stakes quest—and defies seemingly impossible odds—to fulfill his dream of being the first to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

zh.summary: 在冷战期间执行绝密任务时，一名美国海军飞行员（瑞安·雷诺兹饰）被困在敌后，他唯一的生还机会是与一位古怪的前克格勃特工（肯尼思·布拉纳饰）结盟。
zh.summary_original: When a U.S. Navy pilot (Ryan Reynolds) on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent (Kenneth Branagh).

zh.summary: 由《兄弟连》和《太平洋战争》的制片人史蒂芬·斯皮尔伯格、汤姆·汉克斯和加里·戈茨曼倾力打造。在第二次世界大战期间，第100轰炸大队的飞行员们冒着生命危险，这是一支由勇气、牺牲和胜利凝聚而成的兄弟连。
zh.summary_original: From Steven Spielberg, Tom Hanks, and Gary Goetzman—the producers of Band of Brothers and The Pacific. During World War II, airmen risk their lives with the 100th Bomb Group, a brotherhood forged by courage, loss, and triumph.

zh.summary: 当一笔数百万美元的抢劫案出现差错时，骗子拉奇（安雅·泰勒-乔伊饰）被迫踏上逃亡之路。在联邦调查局和一个冷酷无情的犯罪头目的双重追捕下，拉奇必须为自己的生命而战——并寻找一条出路。
zh.summary_original: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky (Anya Taylor-Joy) is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

zh.summary: 赛车传奇人物桑尼·海耶斯被说服去带领一支挣扎中的一级方程式车队——并指导一位年轻的新星车手——同时追寻最后一次自我救赎的机会。
zh.summary_original: Racing legend Sonny Hayes is coaxed into leading a struggling Formula 1 team—and mentoring a young hotshot driver—while chasing one last chance at redemption.

zh.summary: 当一名纵火调查员勉强与一名刑警合作时，他们阻止两名纵火犯的竞赛点燃了一场充满秘密和怀疑的扭曲游戏。
zh.summary_original: When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.

zh.summary: 塔玛是一名摩萨德黑客特工，她以假身份潜入德黑兰，以协助摧毁伊朗的核反应堆。但当任务失败时，塔玛必须策划一场行动，这将使她所有珍视的人都陷入危险之中。
zh.summary_original: Tamar is a Mossad hacker-agent who infiltrates Tehran under a false identity to help destroy Iran’s nuclear reactor. But when her mission fails, Tamar must plan an operation that will place everyone dear to her in jeopardy.

zh.summary: 踏上一场关于夏威夷及其人民起源的史诗冒险。杰森·莫玛饰演无畏的战士卡ʻ伊阿纳，在四个王国爆发重大权力斗争之际，肩负起统一故乡的使命。
zh.summary_original: Embark on an epic adventure about the origin of Hawai‘i and its people. Jason Momoa stars as Kaʻiana, a fearless warrior on a mission to unite his homeland as a monumental power struggle erupts among the four kingdoms.

zh.summary: 2021年奥斯卡®提名作品。在一个由真实事件启发的惊心动魄的二战故事中，欧内斯特·克劳斯船长（汤姆·汉克斯饰）率领由37艘船只组成的国际船队，执行横跨大西洋的危险任务，向盟军运送士兵和物资。
zh.summary_original: 2021 Oscar® nominee. In a thrilling WWII story inspired by actual events, Captain Ernest Krause (Tom Hanks) leads an international convoy of 37 ships on a treacherous mission across the Atlantic to deliver soldiers and supplies to Allied forces.

zh.summary: 两个死对头排难专家（乔治·克鲁尼和布拉德·皮特）在奉命去掩盖一位纽约知名官员的失误时意外碰面。在一个惊心动魄的夜晚，他们必须放下琐碎的恩怨和自我，才能完成任务。
zh.summary_original: Two rival fixers (George Clooney and Brad Pitt) cross paths when they’re both called in to help cover up a prominent New York official’s misstep. Over one explosive night, they’ll have to set aside their petty grievances—and their egos—to finish the job.

zh.summary: 一位坚定的父亲（马修·麦康纳饰）冒着一切危险，将一位敬业的教师（亚美莉卡·费雷拉饰）和她的学生从肆虐的野火中解救出来。本片改编自真实的求生故事。
zh.summary_original: A determined father (Matthew McConaughey) risks everything to rescue a dedicated teacher (America Ferrera) and her students from a raging wildfire. Inspired by a true story of survival.

zh.summary: 深入剖析这位法国军事领袖的出身及其迅速而残酷的皇帝晋升之路。故事通过拿破仑与他的妻子兼挚爱约瑟芬之间令人痴迷且动荡不安的关系这一视角来展开。
zh.summary_original: A personal look at the French military leader’s origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor. The story is viewed through the prism of Napoleon’s addictive, volatile relationship with his wife and one true love, Josephine.

zh.summary: 在这部对经典电影的史诗级重新构想中，十一岁的小男孩凯文对历史的热情经受了考验，他加入了一群乌合之众般的时空旅行小偷，展开了一场高风险而又爆笑的冒险。
zh.summary_original: Eleven-year-old Kevin’s passion for history is put to the test when he joins a ragtag group of time-traveling thieves on a high-stakes and hilarious adventure in this epic reimagining of the iconic film.

zh.summary: 通过48分钟的全新片段，全方位领略这部史诗巨作的辉煌。通过拿破仑与妻子约瑟芬多变的复杂关系这一视角，这是一部关于这位法国军事领袖的出身以及迅速、无情地攀升为皇帝的个人审视。
zh.summary_original: Witness this epic in its full glory with 48 minutes of new footage. A personal look at the French military leader’s origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor, it's viewed through the prism of Napoleon’s volatile relationship with his wife, Josephine.

works.en: The Completely Made-Up Adventures of Dick Turpin

zh.summary: 传奇江洋大盗迪克·特平被迫成为一帮逃犯的不情愿领袖，并肩负着智胜极其腐败的执法官乔纳森·维尔德的任务，从而开启了一系列极度荒诞的奇遇。
zh.summary_original: Legendary highwayman Dick Turpin sets out on a series of wildly absurd escapades when he’s made the reluctant leader of a band of outlaws—and tasked with outwitting utterly corrupt lawman Jonathan Wilde.

zh.summary: 在二战时期的伦敦，九岁的乔治被母亲丽塔疏散到乡下以躲避轰炸。乔治不服管教且决心回到家人身边，踏上了一段史诗般危险的回家之旅，而丽塔也在寻找他。
zh.summary_original: In World War II London, nine-year-old George is evacuated to the countryside by his mother, Rita, to escape the bombings. Defiant and determined to return to his family, George embarks on an epic, perilous journey back home as Rita searches for him.

zh.summary: 丹·摩根有很多身份：一位尽职的丈夫、慈爱的父亲、著名的汽车推销员。他同时也是一名退休的刺客。当他的过去找上门来时，他被迫带着毫无防备的家人踏上了一场无与伦比的公路旅行。
zh.summary_original: Dan Morgan is many things: a devoted husband, a loving father, a celebrated car salesman. He’s also a former assassin. And when his past catches up to his present, he’s forced to take his unsuspecting family on a road trip unlike any other.

zh.summary: 既然丹的刺客生涯已经抛在脑后，他圣诞节唯一的愿望就是和孩子们度过一段美好的时光。但当得知女儿有自己的计划时，他预订了一趟伦敦的家庭旅行，这却让他们所有人陷入了一个意想不到的敌人的视线之中。
zh.summary_original: Now that Dan’s assassin days are behind him, all he wants for Christmas is quality time with his kids. But when he learns his daughter has her own plans, he books a family trip to London—putting them all in the crosshairs of an unexpected enemy.

zh.summary: 当她的小说情节与一个险恶的地下辛迪加的活动过于接近时，性格内向的间谍小说家埃莉·康威和她的猫被卷入了真实的间谍世界——在这里，没有任何事和任何人是表面看起来的那样。
zh.summary_original: When the plots of her books get too close to the activities of a sinister underground syndicate, introverted spy novelist Elly Conway and her cat are plunged into the real world of espionage—where nothing, and no one, is what it seems.

zh.summary: 质朴踏实的科尔对神秘的萨迪一见倾心——但随后震惊地发现她是一名秘密特工。在他们决定是否有第二次约会之前，科尔和萨迪就被卷入了一场拯救世界的国际冒险之中。
zh.summary_original: Salt-of-the-earth Cole falls head over heels for enigmatic Sadie—but then makes the shocking discovery that she’s a secret agent. Before they can decide on a second date, Cole and Sadie are swept away on an international adventure to save the world.

zh.summary: 两名特工（也是昔日恋人）必须携手合作，打击威胁英国的国际网络攻击，同时正视他们那段充满破坏性的关系中深埋的秘密。
zh.summary_original: Two agents—and former lovers—must work together to combat international cyberattacks threatening the UK while also confronting the buried secrets of their destructive relationship.
zh.title: 非常关系

zh.summary: Chickie (Zac Efron) 想通过做一件疯狂的事来支持在越南作战的朋友——亲自给他们带去美国啤酒。这段出于好意的旅程迅速改变了 Chickie 的生活和视角。改编自真实故事。
zh.summary_original: Chickie (Zac Efron) wants to support his friends fighting in Vietnam by doing something wild—personally bringing them American beer. What starts as a well-meaning journey quickly changes Chickie’s life and perspective. Based on a true story.

zh.summary: 当一架运送囚犯的飞机在阿拉斯加的一个崎岖小镇附近可疑坠毁时，该地区的美国法警发起了一场针对数十名暴力重犯的搜捕行动，而他认为这一切背后是一个犯罪主谋。
zh.summary_original: When a prison transport plane suspiciously crashes near a rugged Alaskan town, the region’s U.S. marshal ignites a manhunt for dozens of violent inmates—and the criminal mastermind he believes is behind it all.

zh.summary: 罗里和科比是一对意想不到的搭档：一个走投无路的父亲和一个因抢劫凑到一起的前囚犯。当抢劫计划出现差错时，他们与一个不同寻常的同谋——罗里的心理治疗师——联手，以甩开警察、冥顽不灵的官僚和一个心狠手辣的犯罪头目。
zh.summary_original: Rory and Cobby are unlikely partners: a desperate father and an ex-con thrown together for a heist. When it goes awry, they team up with an unusual accomplice—Rory’s therapist—to outrun police, backward bureaucrats, and a vengeful crime boss.

zh.summary: 一位寻宝策划大师（约翰·卡拉辛斯基饰）组建了一支队伍，去开启一场改变一生的冒险。但为了在每一步都智胜并甩开威胁，他需要一个比他更聪明的人：他疏远的妹妹（娜塔莉·波特曼饰）
zh.summary_original: A treasure-hunting mastermind (John Krasinski) assembles a team for a life-changing adventure. But to outwit and outrun threats at every turn, he’ll need someone even smarter than he is: his estranged sister (Natalie Portman).

zh.summary: 自从他的女友七年前失踪以来，Michael 的生活一直停滞不前。但旧日记中的一份神秘食谱承诺给出他一直渴望的答案。
zh.summary_original: Since his girlfriend went missing seven years ago, Michael’s life has been on hold. But a mystical recipe in an old journal promises to give the answers he’s been longing for.

zh.summary: 吉米在努力悲痛于妻子的离去的同时，还要扮演好父亲、朋友和治疗师的角色。他决定对遇到的每个人尝试一种新方法：毫无保留的残酷诚实。这会让事情变好，还是会引发爆笑的混乱？
zh.summary_original: Jimmy is struggling to grieve the loss of his wife while being a dad, friend, and therapist. He decides to try a new approach with everyone in his path: unfiltered, brutal honesty. Will it make things better—or unleash uproarious chaos?

zh.summary: 当一位金融巨头（乔恩·哈姆饰）突然发现自己离婚且失业时，他开始抢劫富裕的邻居以维持生计。从自己的社交圈偷窃奇怪地让他兴奋，但他逐渐陷入了一个致命的网中。
zh.summary_original: When a financial titan (Jon Hamm) suddenly finds himself divorced and jobless, he starts robbing his wealthy neighbors to stay afloat. Stealing from his own social circle strangely exhilarates him—but he gradually gets tangled in a deadly web.

zh.summary: 揭开早间电视节目的神秘面纱。这部毫不掩饰坦率的剧集由瑞茜·威瑟斯彭和詹妮弗·安妮斯顿主演，通过帮助美国人醒来的人们的视角来审视现代职场。
zh.summary_original: Pull back the curtain on early morning TV. Starring Reese Witherspoon and Jennifer Aniston, this unapologetically candid drama looks at the modern workplace through the lens of the people who help America wake up.

zh.summary: 由M·奈特·沙马兰打造，讲述了一对费城夫妇在遭遇难以言喻的悲剧后陷入哀痛，这场悲剧导致他们的婚姻出现裂痕，并为一股神秘力量进入他们的家打开了大门。
zh.summary_original: From M. Night Shyamalan, Servant follows a Philadelphia couple in mourning after an unspeakable tragedy creates a rift in their marriage and opens the door for a mysterious force to enter their home.

zh.summary: 尼基和杰森梦寐以求的就是一个孩子——偏偏这是他们无法拥有的。于是他们决定领养。面对他们那不靠谱的朋友、戏剧化的亲戚和混乱的生活，这对夫妇能成功建立他们梦想中的家庭吗？
zh.summary_original: All Nikki and Jason want is a baby—the one thing they can’t have. So they decide to adopt. With their dysfunctional friends, dramatic relatives, and chaotic lives, will the couple succeed in building the family of their dreams?

zh.summary: 由执行制片人马丁·斯科塞斯和史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格倾力打造。当被定罪的谋杀犯马克斯·卡迪刑满释放后，他开始渗入当年协助将他送进监狱的那对已婚律师夫妇的家庭。
zh.summary_original: From executive producers Martin Scorsese and Steven Spielberg. When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

zh.summary: 在这部由《邻居大战》导演执导的剧集中，一对中年将至、曾经是至交好友的纯洁男女（塞斯·罗根和萝丝·拜恩饰）在长期疏远后重新联系。两人的友谊变得愈发密不可分，并以一种令人捧腹的方式扰乱了他们的生活。
zh.summary_original: In this series from the director of Neighbors, a platonic pair of former best friends approaching midlife (Seth Rogen and Rose Byrne) reconnect after a long rift. The duo’s friendship becomes more consuming—and destabilizes their lives in a hilarious way.

zh.summary: 芝加哥检察官办公室发生了一起骇人听闻的谋杀案，其中一名同事被怀疑是罪魁祸首，这使得被告（杰克·吉伦哈尔饰）不得不奋力维持家庭的和睦。
zh.summary_original: A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney’s Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused (Jake Gyllenhaal) fighting to keep his family together.

zh.summary: 在一群劫机者控制飞机后，谈判专家萨姆·纳尔逊将迎来他人生中最惊险的旅程，机上的所有人也是如此。随着赌注每秒都在增加，萨姆将尝试他策略中的每一个招数来制服他们……
zh.summary_original: Expert negotiator Sam Nelson is in for the ride of his life—and so is everyone on board with him—after a group of hijackers take control. Sam will try every move in his playbook to take them down…as the stakes grow higher by the second.
zh.title: 历劫惊途

zh.summary: 取材自真实事件。当吉米·基恩开始服刑10年时，他得到一个难以置信的提议：如果他能从疑似杀人犯拉里·霍尔那里套出供词，吉米就会获得自由。完成这项任务成了他一生的挑战。
zh.summary_original: Inspired by actual events. As Jimmy Keene begins a 10-year prison sentence, he gets an incredible offer: If he can elicit a confession from suspected killer Larry Hall, Jimmy will be freed. Completing this mission becomes the challenge of a lifetime.

zh.summary: 加维家感情深厚的姐妹们一直守望相助。但当她们所有人都希望其死去的有毒姐夫/妹夫真的死去时，这彻底颠覆了她们的生活，并空前地考验了她们的羁绊。
zh.summary_original: The tight-knit Garvey sisters have always looked out for one another. But when the toxic brother-in-law they all wanted dead actually dies, it turns their lives upside down and tests their bond like nothing before.

zh.summary: 与结婚 20 年的丈夫离婚后，Molly Novak 必须弄清楚如何处理她高达 870 亿美元的离婚赡养费。她决定重新参与慈善基金会并重新融入现实世界——在此过程中找回自我。
zh.summary_original: After divorcing her husband of 20 years, Molly Novak must figure out what to do with her $87 billion settlement. She decides to reengage with her charitable foundation and reconnect with the real world—finding herself along the way.

zh.summary: 克拉特夫妇的女儿失踪后，他们决定自己动手，策划了一个疯狂的计划：监视这个社区。随着他们涉足业余间谍活动，一个又一个令人震惊的秘密浮出水面。
zh.summary_original: After the Klatts’ daughter goes missing, they take matters into their own hands and hatch a wild plan: Spy on the neighborhood. As they make their way into small-time espionage, shocking secrets come to light one by one.

zh.summary: Margo是一位前Hooters女服务员和前职业摔跤手的女儿，也是一名刚从大学辍学的有志作家。面对一个新生婴儿、如山般堆积的账单以及越来越少的支付账单的方法，Margo必须找到前进的道路。
zh.summary_original: The daughter of a former Hooters waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

zh.summary: 塞斯·罗根饰演新上任的电影公司负责人。为了获得名人的认可，他和他在大陆电影公司的管理团队必须在公司要求与创作抱负之间寻找平衡，努力让电影保持活力与现实意义。
zh.summary_original: Seth Rogen stars as the newly appointed head of a movie studio. Desperate for celebrity approval, he and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

zh.summary: 由NBA球星凯文·杜兰特、电影制作人雷吉·洛克·拜斯伍德以及《胜利之光》幕后团队倾情打造。一名篮球神童必须穿过重重压力的迷宫，才能战胜逆境，并领悟到真正拥有自信与风范的含义。
zh.summary_original: From NBA star Kevin Durant, filmmaker Reggie Rock Bythewood, and the team behind Friday Night Lights. A basketball prodigy must navigate a maze of pressure if he’s going to overcome the odds against him and learn what it truly means to have swagger.
zh.title: 昂首阔步

zh.summary: 在一次残酷的袭击让她陷入不断变化的现实多年之后，柯比·马泽拉奇得知最近的一起谋杀案与她的遭遇有关。她与资深记者丹·贝拉斯克斯联手，以理解她不断变化的现在，并直面她的过去。
zh.summary_original: Years after a brutal attack left her in a constantly shifting reality, Kirby Mazrachi learns that a recent murder is linked to her assault. She teams with veteran reporter Dan Velazquez to understand her ever-changing present—and confront her past.

zh.summary: 在20世纪70年代的墨西哥，四名女性打破极保守的规范，加入了第一支女子警察部队——却发现这只是一场用于转移公众对连环杀手视线的噱头。随着尸体数量不断增加，她们誓言将凶手绳之以法。灵感源自真实事件。
zh.summary_original: In 1970s Mexico, four women defy ultraconservative norms and join the first female police force—only to discover it’s a publicity stunt to distract from a serial killer. As the body count grows, they vow to bring the killer to justice. Inspired by true events.

zh.summary: 这部令人毛骨悚然的惊悚片改编自斯蒂芬·金的小说，讲述了寡妇莉西·兰登（朱丽安·摩尔饰）的故事，一系列令人不安的事件唤醒了她对与作家丈夫斯科特·兰登（克里夫·欧文饰）的婚姻以及困扰他的黑暗的回忆。
zh.summary_original: Based on the novel by Stephen King, this terrifying thriller follows widow Lisey Landon (Julianne Moore) as a series of disturbing events revives memories of her marriage to author Scott Landon (Clive Owen) and the darkness that plagued him.
zh.title: 莉西的故事

detailMetadata.summary: 刚离婚、带着娃的女子Paula陷入了勒索、谋杀和青少年足球的“兔子洞”，她确信自己见证了一场犯罪，同时挣扎于争夺孩子的监护权和身份危机。为此，Paula开始自行调查案件，可能会揭露一场更大的阴谋，也是她重建自己的家庭和自我的关键。
detailMetadata.title: 极致欢愉保障

detailSeasons.summary: 刚离婚、带着娃的女子Paula陷入了勒索、谋杀和青少年足球的“兔子洞”，她确信自己见证了一场犯罪，同时挣扎于争夺孩子的监护权和身份危机。为此，Paula开始自行调查案件，可能会揭露一场更大的阴谋，也是她重建自己的家庭和自我的关键。
detailSeasons.title: 极致欢愉保障

zh.summary: 一位刚离婚的妈妈陷入了由勒索、谋杀和青少年足球交织而成的危险深渊。
zh.summary_original: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

zh.summary: 在20世纪50年代，伊丽莎白·赞特的科学家梦想遭到了认为女性属于家庭领域的社会的挑战。她接受了一份电视烹饪节目的工作，并开始教导全国被忽视的主妇们远超食谱的知识。
zh.summary_original: In the 1950s, Elizabeth Zott’s dream of being a scientist is challenged by a society that says women belong in the domestic sphere. She accepts a job on a TV cooking show and sets out to teach a nation of overlooked housewives way more than recipes.

zh.summary: 认识一下打造史上最大规模多人电子游戏背后的团队。但在一个专注于构建世界、塑造英雄和创造传奇的工作场所中，最艰难的战斗并非发生在游戏里，而是发生在办公室里。
zh.summary_original: Meet the team behind the biggest multiplayer video game of all time. But in a workplace focused on building worlds, molding heroes, and creating legends, the most hard-fought battles don’t occur in the game—they happen in the office.

zh.summary: 一群热爱寻欢作乐的美国女孩身着束腰外衣闯入1870年代的伦敦，引发了一场英美文化冲突。这些女海盗被派去寻找丈夫和地位，但她们的心中所求远不止于此。
zh.summary_original: A group of fun-loving American girls burst onto the scene in tightly corseted 1870s London, kicking off an Anglo-American culture clash. Sent to secure husbands and status, the buccaneers’ hearts are set on much more than that.

zh.summary: 伦敦警探黑加蒂和伦克都坚信要打击犯罪，但对于正确的方法有着截然不同的看法。他们被迫结成谁都没有要求的伙伴关系，必须在这个瞬息万变的世界中合作伸张正义。
zh.summary_original: London detectives Hegarty and Lenker both believe in fighting crime—but have very different ideas about the right way to do it. Forced into a partnership neither of them asked for, they must work together to serve justice in a rapidly changing world.

zh.summary: 1984年，马克西莫·加利亚多在阿卡普尔科最热门的度假村拉斯科利纳斯得到了梦寐以求的工作，梦想成真。但他很快意识到，在那里工作将比他想象的要复杂得多。
zh.summary_original: In 1984, Maximo Gallardo’s dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at Acapulco’s hottest resort, Las Colinas. But he soon realizes that working there will be far more complicated than he ever imagined.
zh.title: 阿卡普高

zh.summary: 在这部爆笑的谋杀悬疑剧中，一切似乎都并非表面那样，每个嫌疑人的故事都通过不同的流派来讲述。
zh.summary_original: Nothing is as it seems in this hilarious murder mystery where each suspect’s story is told through a different genre.

zh.summary: 本剧由《流人》执行制片人打造。当英国郊区的一栋房屋神秘爆炸时，一位热心的邻居与一名私家侦探联手探寻真相，却发现自己身陷一场令人不寒栗的政府阴谋之中。
zh.summary_original: From the executive producers of Slow Horses. When a house mysteriously explodes in the British suburbs, a concerned neighbor teams up with a private investigator to find the truth—landing them in the middle of a chilling government conspiracy.

zh.summary: 在这部扣人心弦的律政惊悚片中，当儿子被指控谋杀同班同学时，一个家庭的生活被彻底打破。克里斯·埃文斯、米歇尔·道克瑞和杰登·马泰尔主演了这部改编自威廉·兰代尔畅销小说的作品。
zh.summary_original: A family’s lives are irreparably disrupted when the son is accused of murdering a fellow classmate in this dramatic legal thriller. Chris Evans, Michelle Dockery, and Jaeden Martell star in the adaptation of William Landay’s bestselling novel.

zh.summary: 深入真实的犯罪播客世界。这部荣获美国全国有色人种协进会形象奖的剧集由奥克塔维亚·斯宾塞主演，她饰演一名播客，为了追求真相和正义，不惜冒着包括生命在内的一切风险。
zh.summary_original: Descend into the world of true-crime podcasts. This NAACP Image Award–winning drama stars Octavia Spencer as a podcaster who risks everything—including her life—to pursue truth and justice.

zh.summary: 海莉·斯坦菲尔德饰演埃米莉·狄金森。诗人。女儿。彻头彻尾的叛逆者。在这部成长故事中，埃米莉决心成为世界上最伟大的诗人。
zh.summary_original: Hailee Steinfeld stars as Emily Dickinson. Poet. Daughter. Total rebel. In this coming-of-age story, Emily’s determined to become the world’s greatest poet.

zh.summary: 正当葡萄酒界为亚历山大·莱热的逝世而哀悼时，他疏远的女儿卡米尔得知他非凡的藏酒现在归她所有。但在这之前，卡米尔必须在一场感官测试中战胜亚历山大的门徒一诚。
zh.summary_original: While the world of wine mourns the death of Alexandre Léger, his estranged daughter, Camille, learns his extraordinary collection is now hers. But before she can claim her inheritance, Camille must best Alexandre’s protégé, Issei, in a test of their senses.

zh.summary: 当一台神秘机器出现并承诺揭示每个人的真正潜力时，一个小镇永远改变了。不久之后，居民们开始更换工作、重新思考人际关系并质疑长期持有的信念——这一切都是为了追求更好的未来。
zh.summary_original: A small town is forever changed when a mysterious machine appears, promising to reveal everyone’s true potential. Soon residents start changing jobs, rethinking relationships, and questioning long-held beliefs—all in pursuit of a better future.
zh.title: 大门奖

zh.summary: 这部宏大的传奇故事改编自《纽约时报》畅销书，记录了一个朝鲜移民家庭四代人的希望与梦想，他们离开祖国，为生存和繁荣展开了不屈不挠的求索。
zh.summary_original: Based on the New York Times bestseller, this sweeping saga chronicles the hopes and dreams of a Korean immigrant family across four generations as they leave their homeland in an indomitable quest to survive and thrive.

zh.summary: 费城两个挚友（布莱恩·泰里·亨利与瓦格纳·马拉饰）伪装成美国缉毒局特工，去抢劫小型毒贩。这是一个完美的骗局——直到他们选错了目标，并成为一个庞大贩毒集团的目标。
zh.summary_original: Two lifelong friends (Brian Tyree Henry and Wagner Moura) in Philadelphia pose as DEA agents to rob small-time drug dealers. It’s a perfect grift—until they choose the wrong mark and become targets of a massive narcotics enterprise.

zh.summary: 一份神秘的快递威胁要暴露一位知名记者的过去。凯特·布兰切特和凯文·克莱恩主演，由阿方索·卡隆担任编剧并执导的剧集。
zh.summary_original: A mysterious delivery threatens to expose a celebrated journalist’s past. Cate Blanchett and Kevin Kline star in a series written for the screen and directed by Alfonso Cuarón.

zh.summary: 天才发明家、固执的理想主义者艾利·福克斯带着家人踏上了一段穿过墨西哥的危险旅程，以逃避美国政府的追捕并寻找安全之所。
zh.summary_original: Allie Fox—a brilliant inventor and stubborn idealist—uproots his family for a dangerous quest through Mexico to flee the U.S. government and find safety.

zh.summary: 当才华横溢的科学家安布尔·切斯伯勒在哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉边境失踪时，她的哥哥和丈夫——两人都是美国陆军精锐突击队员——在游击战中艰难地寻找她，却发现他们深爱的女人可能藏着一个秘密。
zh.summary_original: When brilliant scientist Amber Chesborough vanishes along the Colombia-Venezuela border, her brother and her husband—both elite U.S. Army commandos—struggle to find her amid a guerilla war, discovering that the woman they love might have a secret.
zh.title: 回声三号

zh.summary: 本剧灵感来源于真实事件，以及贯穿这一切的核心爱情故事。WeWork在不到十年的时间里，从一个单一的联合办公空间发展成为一个价值470亿美元的全球品牌。然而在不到一年的时间里，其估值暴跌了400亿美元。发生了什么？
zh.summary_original: Inspired by actual events—and the love story at the center of it all. WeWork grew from a single coworking space into a global brand worth $47 billion in under a decade. Then, in less than a year, its valuation dropped $40 billion. What happened?

zh.summary: 乔希和梅丽莎是一对生活困顿的情侣，当他们被困在一个充满魔力的音乐小镇，并肩负必须完成的任务时，他们的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。
zh.summary_original: Josh and Melissa are a struggling couple whose lives are transformed when they get trapped in a magical musical town—with a mission they must complete.
zh.title: 音乐魔法镇！

zh.summary: 希拉·鲁宾是20世纪80年代圣迭戈的一名默默承受痛苦的家庭主妇。在私下里，她与极端的个人心魔和恶毒的内心声音作斗争。但当她发现有氧健身操时，事情发生了变化，开启了一段通往赋权与成功的旅程。
zh.summary_original: Sheila Rubin is a quietly tormented housewife in ’80s San Diego. Behind closed doors, she battles extreme personal demons and a vicious inner voice. But things change when she discovers aerobics, sparking a journey toward empowerment and success.

zh.summary: 一个受到年轻调查记者报道启发而创作的神秘故事。当希尔德和她的家人搬回她父亲离开的小镇时，她对真相的追寻揭开了令人震惊的秘密。
zh.summary_original: A mystery inspired by the reporting of a young investigative journalist. When Hilde and her family move back to the small town her father left behind, her pursuit of the truth leads to the unearthing of shocking secrets.

zh.summary: 阿波罗和艾玛的爱情故事宛如童话，直到艾玛神秘失踪。悲痛欲绝的阿波罗发现自己踏上了一场九死一生的奥德赛之旅，穿梭于一个他从未知道其存在的纽约市。改编自获奖小说。
zh.summary_original: Apollo and Emma’s love story is a fairy tale—until Emma mysteriously vanishes. Bereft, Apollo finds himself on a death-defying odyssey through a New York City he didn’t know existed. Based on the award-winning novel.
zh.title: 叛徒

zh.summary: 在这部动画音乐喜剧中，欧文·蒂勒曼和他的家人在纽约繁华的中央公园过着非同寻常的生活，公园由欧文管理。现在，他们必须抵御一个想要把公园变成公寓大楼的富有酒店女继承人。
zh.summary_original: In this animated musical comedy, Owen Tillerman and his family live an unconventional life in New York's bustling Central Park, which Owen manages. Now, they'll have to fend off a wealthy hotel heiress who wants to turn the park into condos.

zh.summary: 改编自卡特里娜飓风期间的真实事件。当洪水上涨、电力中断、酷暑难耐时，新奥尔良一家医院里筋疲力尽的医护人员被迫做出重大而揪心的决定。
zh.summary_original: Based on actual events from Hurricane Katrina. When the floodwaters rose, power failed, and heat soared, exhausted caregivers at a New Orleans hospital were forced to make profound, heart-wrenching decisions.

zh.summary: 1966年，一名年轻女孩的失踪震惊了巴尔的摩市，两个女人的生活在一条致命的碰撞曲线上交汇了。
zh.summary_original: When the disappearance of a young girl grips the city of Baltimore in 1966, the lives of two women converge on a fatal collision course.

zh.summary: 一部关于历史中最广为人知却又最少被理解的罪行的阴谋惊悚片。在亚伯拉罕·林肯遇刺后，随着国家命运悬于一线，这是追捕约翰·威尔克斯·布思的惊人故事。
zh.summary_original: A conspiracy thriller about one of the best known but least understood crimes in history. This is the astonishing story of the hunt for John Wilkes Booth in the aftermath of Abraham Lincoln’s assassination—as the fate of the country hangs in the balance.

zh.summary: 欢迎来到一个与我们自己的星球相去不远遥远星球，这里有关于生活、爱情和友谊的爆笑而又辛酸的观察——以最奇特的方式讲述。由创作者内森·W·派尔和丹·哈蒙倾力打造。
zh.summary_original: Welcome to a distant planet not unlike our own, with hilarious yet poignant observations on life, love, and friendship—told in the most peculiar way. From creators Nathan W. Pyle and Dan Harmon.
zh.title: 奇异星球

zh.summary: 1776年12月，本杰明·富兰克林因其电学实验而闻名于世。然而，当他踏上一项前往法国的秘密任务时，他的激情和能力受到了考验，而美国独立的命运也悬于一线。
zh.summary_original: In December 1776, Benjamin Franklin is world-famous for his electrical experiments. But his passion and power are put to the test when he embarks on a secret mission to France—with the fate of American independence hanging in the balance.

detailMetadata.summary: 弗兰克（伯努瓦·马吉梅尔饰）和他的老朋友们喜欢一起在周末打猎，但某个星期天，他们遇到另一群猎人，这群人毫无理由地开始攻击他们。当他们一行中的一人中枪时，弗兰克的朋友们反击，将一名袭击者击倒。他们勉强逃脱后，四人决定将这件事隐瞒下来。弗兰克试图回归正常生活，与妻子克里斯特尔（梅拉尼·罗兰饰）一起生活，但接下来的几天，他开始感到自己和朋友们似乎被人监视，甚至更糟——那些猎人似乎正在追踪他们，决心复仇。
detailMetadata.title: 猎杀

detailSeasons.summary: 弗兰克（伯努瓦·马吉梅尔饰）和他的老朋友们喜欢一起在周末打猎，但某个星期天，他们遇到另一群猎人，这群人毫无理由地开始攻击他们。当他们一行中的一人中枪时，弗兰克的朋友们反击，将一名袭击者击倒。他们勉强逃脱后，四人决定将这件事隐瞒下来。弗兰克试图回归正常生活，与妻子克里斯特尔（梅拉尼·罗兰饰）一起生活，但接下来的几天，他开始感到自己和朋友们似乎被人监视，甚至更糟——那些猎人似乎正在追踪他们，决心复仇。
detailSeasons.title: 猎杀

zh.summary: 当打猎途中的朋友们与其它猎人发生致命冲突时，他们发誓保守秘密。但随着多疑情绪的滋生——以及一个冷酷无情的帮派寻求报复——朋友们必须面对他们的道德、家庭和野蛮本能。
zh.summary_original: When friends on a hunting trip get into a deadly clash with other hunters, they vow to keep it a secret. But as paranoia sets in—and a ruthless gang seeks revenge—the friends must confront their morality, families, and savage instincts.

zh.summary: 一次母女海外度假发生了毁灭性的转折，Gali因涉嫌藏毒被捕。她的母亲Orna拒绝接受这些指控，为寻求自由押上了一切——却反而陷入了Gali的秘密网络之中。
zh.summary_original: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali’s secrets.

zh.summary: 加拉（伊娃·朗格利亚饰）是一位纽约社交名媛，带着母亲和女儿在一个古朴的西班牙小镇上逃亡。加拉的新生活让她遇到了一个言行鲁莽但迷人的酒庄主人，以及深不见底的家族秘密。
zh.summary_original: Gala (Eva Longoria) is a New York City socialite on the run in a quaint Spanish town with her mother and daughter. Gala’s new life brings her into the path of a brash but charming winery owner—and a deep well of family secrets.
zh.title: 女人领地

zh.summary: 伦敦寡妇科拉·西伯恩搬到埃塞克斯去调查关于神话中海蛇的传闻。她与当地牧师建立了一种基于科学和怀疑论的奇妙纽带——但当悲剧降临时，当地人指责她吸引了那个生物。
zh.summary_original: London widow Cora Seaborne moves to Essex to investigate reports of a mythical serpent. She forms a surprising bond of science and skepticism with the local vicar—but when tragedy strikes, locals accuse her of attracting the creature.

zh.summary: 由《健听女孩》的导演兼奥斯卡®获奖编剧倾力打造，《小美国》是一部诗选剧，展现了美国移民们搞笑、浪漫、感人、鼓舞人心且令人惊叹的故事。
zh.summary_original: From the director and Oscar®-winning writer of CODA, Little America is an anthology series that observes the funny, romantic, heartfelt, inspiring, and surprising stories of immigrants in America.

zh.summary: 在这四个独立的故事中，深入探索《神话任务》的宇宙。跟随玩家、漫画店老板、巡回乐团音乐家以及美术部门成员的生活，看他们在寻找社群、成功与爱的过程中前行。
zh.summary_original: Go deeper into the Mythic Quest universe in these four standalone stories. Follow the lives of players, comic book shop owners, touring orchestra musicians, and members of the art department as they search for community, success, and love.

zh.summary: 在1969年，一位雄心勃勃的女性渴望跨越富有者和一无所有者之间的界限，在全美最具排他性、时尚且充满背叛的桌面上为自己争取一席之地：棕榈滩上流社会。
zh.summary_original: In 1969, an ambitious woman aspires to cross the line between the haves and have-nots to secure her seat at America’s most exclusive, fashionable, and treacherous table: Palm Beach high society.

zh.summary: 如果运气更好一点，选择更好一点，姿态更好一点……乔希·科尔曼本可以成为一名摇滚巨星。现在他教五年级，尽管他热爱他的学生，但在一个有时让人觉得既缺乏幸福又缺乏意义的世界里，他仍然在努力寻找幸福和意义。
zh.summary_original: With better luck, better choices, better posture...Josh Corman could’ve been a rock star. Now he teaches fifth grade, and though he loves his students, he still struggles to find happiness and meaning in a world that sometimes feels short on both.

zh.summary: 这部众星云集的跨流派选集剧集将八个黑色幽默的女性主义寓言交织在一起，以意想不到的方式探讨性别角色、自主权和身份等主题。
zh.summary_original: Featuring an all-star cast, this genre-bending anthology series weaves together eight darkly comedic feminist fables that take unexpected approaches to subjects like gender roles, autonomy, and identity.

zh.summary: 佩吉·纽曼有着一段斑驳的过去，在与她同住在加利福尼亚州尤卡瓦利沙漠小镇的慈母去世后，她做出了改变一生的决定，成为了一名私家侦探。
zh.summary_original: Peggy Newman, a woman with a checkered past, makes the life-changing decision to become a private investigator following the death of her beloved mother, who she lived with in the small desert town of Yucca Valley, California.

zh.summary: 当汉普顿（大卫·奥伊罗饰）出狱时，他期待已久的家庭团聚并没有完全如他所愿。在他缺席期间，汉普顿的妻子和儿子们组成了一个非传统的家庭，他的回归让他们的世界陷入了混乱。
zh.summary_original: When Hampton (David Oyelowo) is released from prison, his long-awaited family reunion doesn’t quite go as he hoped. In his absence, Hampton’s wife and sons formed an unconventional family unit, and his return spins their world into chaos.

zh.summary: 因为失眠而紧密相连，挚友丽莎和丹尼在深夜保持联系，并在他们的关系加深的同时，在一个充满奇妙诡异惊喜的世界中寻找出路。
zh.summary_original: Bonded by insomnia, best friends Lisa and Danny stay connected to each other late into the night and find their way through a world of wonderfully weird surprises as their relationship deepens.
zh.title: 无人入眠

zh.summary: 劳尔的世界正在瓦解。玛尔塔意外怀孕了。在一次葬礼上浪漫邂逅将他们聚在一起后，他们在生活和爱情的混乱中跌跌撞撞前行。
zh.summary_original: Raúl’s world is unraveling. Marta’s unexpectedly pregnant. After a funeral meet-cute brings them together, they stumble through the chaos of life and love.

zh.summary: 当紧急调度员伊恩·里德利接到一个青少年的求救电话，且他认为这名青少年可能是他失踪多年的女儿时，他竭尽全力去寻找她。
zh.summary_original: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

works.en: The Last Thing He Told Me

zh.summary: 一个绝望的继母必须与继女建立关系，并在丈夫失踪、只留下一张神秘便条后，保护她们两人免受危险。
zh.summary_original: A desperate stepmother must forge a relationship with her stepdaughter—and protect them both from danger—after her husband vanishes, leaving nothing but a mysterious note.

detailMetadata.summary: 故事改编自Araminta Hall的2021年小说，聚焦Nancy Hennessy的死，外人看来她的生活是完美的，漂亮、富有、深得相识的人的尊敬和喜爱。而她被谋杀后，留下两个最好的朋友、深爱她的丈夫和女儿，以及一个她至死都未说出身份的秘密恋人。随着对其死亡的调查陷入困难，两个好友Eleanor和Mary也深陷悲痛，黑暗的细节慢慢浮现，让她们发觉自己对好友、对彼此甚至对自己其实都知之甚少。
detailMetadata.title: 不完美女人

detailSeasons.summary: 故事改编自Araminta Hall的2021年小说，聚焦Nancy Hennessy的死，外人看来她的生活是完美的，漂亮、富有、深得相识的人的尊敬和喜爱。而她被谋杀后，留下两个最好的朋友、深爱她的丈夫和女儿，以及一个她至死都未说出身份的秘密恋人。随着对其死亡的调查陷入困难，两个好友Eleanor和Mary也深陷悲痛，黑暗的细节慢慢浮现，让她们发觉自己对好友、对彼此甚至对自己其实都知之甚少。
detailSeasons.title: 不完美女人

zh.summary: 在一桩谋杀案粉碎了三个最好朋友的生活后，一项调查揭露了背叛与震撼的真相，她们长达数十年的情谊受到了考验。
zh.summary_original: After a murder shatters the lives of three best friends, their decades-long bond is tested when an investigation reveals betrayals and shocking truths.
zh.title: 不完美女人

zh.summary: 一部以1979年夏天曼哈顿为背景的心理惊悚片，当时一名年轻男子因一起令人震惊的罪行被捕——而一位意想不到的调查员必须解开背后的谜团。
zh.summary_original: A psychological thriller set in Manhattan in the summer of 1979, when a young man is arrested for a shocking crime—and an unlikely investigator must solve the mystery behind it.

zh.summary: 一次严重的头部创伤导致苏菲失去记忆。在丈夫和朋友的帮助下，苏菲试图拼凑起生活的碎片，她开始对看似完美的表面生活背后的真相产生怀疑。
zh.summary_original: A traumatic head injury leaves Sophie with extreme memory loss. In her quest to put the pieces of her life back together—with help from her husband and friends—Sophie begins to question the truth behind her picture-perfect life.

zh.summary: 一名才华横溢的剑桥数学系学生（利奥·伍道尔饰）正处于重大突破的边缘，而一个神秘的敌人试图阻止他。为了寻求答案和拯救生命，他与一名政府特工联手，揭开一场高风险的阴谋。
zh.summary_original: A brilliant Cambridge math student (Leo Woodall) is on the verge of a major breakthrough when a shadowy enemy tries to stop him. Fighting for answers—and his life—he teams up with a government agent to unravel a high-stakes conspiracy.
zh.title: 主要目标

zh.summary: 四名普通的英国人被指控绑架了一位美国知名媒体大亨的儿子。他们展开了一场与时间赛跑的绝望之举以证明自己的清白，但会有人相信他们吗——他们说的是实话吗？
zh.summary_original: Four ordinary Brits are accused of kidnapping the son of a prominent U.S. media mogul. They embark on a desperate race against time to prove their innocence, but will anyone believe them—and are they telling the truth?

zh.summary: 在悲惨地失去妻子后，儿童精神病医师伊利·阿德勒博士（比利·克里斯托饰）遇到了一名陷入困境的男孩，这个男孩似乎与伊利的过去有着挥之不去的联系。
zh.summary_original: After tragically losing his wife, child psychiatrist Dr. Eli Adler (Billy Crystal) encounters a troubled young boy who seems to have a haunting connection to Eli’s past.

zh.summary: 这部惊心动魄的剧集揭示了时尚偶像克里斯汀·迪奥以及包括可可·香奈儿、皮埃尔·巴尔曼和克里斯托巴尔·巴伦西亚加在内的同代人如何度过第二次世界大战的恐怖并开创现代时尚的惊人故事。
zh.summary_original: This thrilling series reveals the shocking story of how fashion icon Christian Dior and his contemporaries including Coco Chanel, Pierre Balmain, and Cristóbal Balenciaga navigated the horrors of World War Il and launched modern fashion.

zh.summary: 灵感来自马蒂和彻底改变了他的人生随后又将其接管的治疗师的真实故事。当马蒂第一次见到艾克医生时，他只是想更好地划清界限。在30年的时间里，他将全面了解界限——以及当界限被越过时会发生什么。
zh.summary_original: Inspired by the true story of Marty and the therapist who turned his life around...then took it over. When he first meets Dr. Ike, Marty just wants to get better at boundaries. Over 30 years, he'll learn all about them—and what happens when they get crossed.
zh.title: 邻家心理医生

zh.summary: 越狱犯林·福特逃到了20世纪80年代人头攒动的孟买街头，企图销声匿迹。作为该市贫民和被忽视之人的医生，林在通往救赎的漫长道路上找到了意想不到的爱、羁绊与勇气。
zh.summary_original: Escaped convict Lin Ford flees to the teeming streets of 1980s Bombay, looking to disappear. Working as a medic for the city’s poor and neglected, Lin finds unexpected love, connection, and courage on the long road to redemption.

zh.summary: 一个12岁的男孩成为了一起空难中的唯一幸存者。当他和这场悲剧的其他受影响者试图理解所发生的事情时，意想不到的友谊、恋情和社群逐渐形成。
zh.summary_original: A 12-year-old boy becomes the lone survivor of a plane crash. As he and others affected by the tragedy try to make sense of what happened, unexpected friendships, romances, and communities are formed.

works.en: You Would Do It Too (Tú También lo Harías)

zh.summary: 一辆公共汽车被三名劫匪劫持，但他们在逃脱之前就丧命了。每位乘客的说法都一样：一个戴连帽衫的男人拯救了大家。随着案件的展开，英雄与罪犯之间的界限开始模糊。
zh.summary_original: A bus is hijacked by three robbers—who end up dead before they can get away. Every passenger’s story is the same: a hooded man saved the day. As the case unfolds, the line between hero and criminal begins to blur.

zh.summary: 在这部享誉国际的心理惊悚片中，爱丽丝是一位中年电影导演，在抚养家庭后感到迷失。但与蛇蝎美人编剧索菲的一次偶遇，带着爱丽丝踏上了一段不惜一切代价追求成功的痴迷之旅。
zh.summary_original: In this internationally acclaimed psychological thriller, Alice is a middle-aged film director who feels lost since raising her family. But a chance meeting with Sophie, a femme-fatale screenwriter, takes Alice on an obsessive journey toward success at any cost.

zh.summary: 见证世界上第一位名厨安东尼·卡雷姆的崛起，以及他在拿破仑时代法国卷入间谍活动的历程——在那里，操纵一切就是王道。凭借其在美食和诱惑方面的天赋，他成为了争夺权力斗争中的完美武器。
zh.summary_original: Witness the rise of the world’s first celebrity chef, Antonin Carême, and his descent into espionage in Napoleon-era France—where manipulation is king. With his gifts for gastronomy and seduction, he becomes the perfect weapon in a fight for power.

zh.summary: 认识贝丝·金，一位才华横溢的表演者，在应对拒绝、约会闹剧和家庭问题时努力实现自己的梦想。本剧由萨拉·巴雷利斯创作原创音乐，讲述了寻找真实的自我之声以及使用它的勇气的故事。
zh.summary_original: Meet Bess King, a uniquely talented performer struggling to fulfill her dreams while handling rejection, dating drama, and family issues. Featuring original music by Sara Bareilles, this is a story about finding your authentic voice—and the courage to use it.

zh.summary: 2003年7月4日，一名大学生在中央公园中枪。调查将一系列神秘的全市火灾、市中心音乐场景以及一个在众多秘密重压下分崩离析的富裕上城房地产家族串联在了一起。
zh.summary_original: A college student is shot in Central Park on July 4, 2003. The investigation connects a series of mysterious citywide fires, the downtown music scene, and a wealthy uptown real estate family fraying under the strain of the many secrets they keep.
zh.title: 焰火之城

detailMetadata.summary: 发生在迈阿密的这个故事将会探索年轻时对未来的朝气面对成年后的现实的矛盾，一群大学好友在一个狂欢周末中失去了其中的一个朋友，20年后一个突如其来的匿名威胁着剩下五个人的生活，他们只能联合起来找出幕后的真相。
detailMetadata.title: 此时此刻

detailSeasons.summary: 发生在迈阿密的这个故事将会探索年轻时对未来的朝气面对成年后的现实的矛盾，一群大学好友在一个狂欢周末中失去了其中的一个朋友，20年后一个突如其来的匿名威胁着剩下五个人的生活，他们只能联合起来找出幕后的真相。
detailSeasons.title: 此时此刻

zh.summary: 在大学毕业前夕，六个最好的朋友踏上了一个史诗般的周末来庆祝，却发生了致命的转折。将近 20 年后，幸存者们因为一条威胁要揭露那个命运之夜真相的勒索短信而不情愿地重聚。
zh.summary_original: On the eve of college graduation, six best friends embark on an epic weekend to celebrate—but it takes a fatal turn. Nearly 20 years later, the survivors are reluctantly reunited by a blackmail text threatening to expose the truth about that fateful night.

zh.summary: 在这部深入标志性法国高级定制时装屋幕后的作品中，高级时尚与高潮迭起的戏剧性碰撞。当该时装屋背后的家族王朝陷入丑闻时，他们必须找到重塑自我的方法，否则将被竞争对手毁灭。
zh.summary_original: High fashion meets high drama in this behind-the-curtain look at an iconic French haute couture house. When the family dynasty behind the house falls into scandal, they must find a way to reinvent themselves—or be destroyed by their rivals.

zh.summary: 黑豹党联合创始人休伊·P·牛顿争取到了一位意想不到的盟友——好莱坞制片人伯特·施耐德，以躲避联邦调查局的搜捕并逃往古巴。
zh.summary_original: Black Panther Party co-founder Huey P. Newton enlists an unlikely ally—Hollywood producer Bert Schneider—to elude an FBI manhunt and escape to Cuba.

zh.summary: 玛丽加比白天是一名医学生，而到了晚上，她和家人在墨西哥城竞争激烈的私家救护车行业中拯救生命。面对来自两个世界的压力威胁，玛丽加比将不惜一切代价维持生计。
zh.summary_original: Marigaby is a medical student by day—and by night, she saves lives with her family in Mexico City’s high-stakes business of private ambulances. As pressure from both worlds threatens to drag her down, Marigaby will do whatever it takes to stay afloat.
zh.title: 午夜之家

zh.summary: 在私生活分崩离析后，一名寻求全新开始的年轻医生接管了柏林最艰难、最混乱的医院的急诊室。在与员工的抵制和破败系统的抗争中，她必须团结她那特立独行的团队来拯救生命。
zh.summary_original: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin’s toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

zh.summary: 改编自美国电子游戏推销员亨克·罗杰斯（塔伦·埃哲顿饰）及其在1988年发现《俄罗斯方块》的真实故事。当他着手将这款游戏带给全世界时，他踏入了铁幕背后充满谎言与腐败的危险网罗。
zh.summary_original: Based on the true story of American video game salesman Henk Rogers (Taron Egerton) and his discovery of Tetris in 1988. When he sets out to bring the game to the world, he enters a dangerous web of lies and corruption behind the Iron Curtain.

zh.summary: 20世纪20年代，当俄克拉荷马州奥萨吉族土地下发现石油时，奥萨吉族人遭到接连谋杀，直到联邦调查局介入揭开谜团。
zh.summary_original: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

zh.summary: 在20世纪60年代，两位企业家（安东尼·麦凯和塞缪尔·L·杰克逊）制定了一个巧妙的商业计划，以争取住房融合以及获得美国梦的平等机会。尼古拉斯·霍尔特和妮娅·朗联袂主演了这部受真实事件启发的剧情片。
zh.summary_original: In the 1960s, two entrepreneurs (Anthony Mackie and Samuel L. Jackson) hatch an ingenious business plan to fight for housing integration—and equal access to the American Dream. Nicholas Hoult and Nia Long co-star in this drama inspired by true events.

zh.summary: Cherry（Tom Holland 饰）从大学辍学生流落为伊拉克的陆军医疗兵——唯一的精神支柱是他唯一的真爱 Emily（Ciara Bravo 饰）。但在带着创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）从战争中归来后，随着他在世界上艰难寻找自己的位置，他的生活陷入了毒品和犯罪的漩涡。
zh.summary_original: Cherry (Tom Holland) drifts from college dropout to army medic in Iraq—anchored only by his one true love, Emily (Ciara Bravo). But after returning from the war with PTSD, his life spirals into drugs and crime as he struggles to find his place in the world.

zh.summary: 取材于一个男人愿意为家人和自由付出一切的动人真实故事。当身为主奴的彼得冒着生命危险逃跑并重回家人身边时，他踏上了一段充满爱与忍耐的危险旅程。
zh.summary_original: Inspired by the gripping true story of a man who would do anything for his family—and for freedom. When Peter, an enslaved man, risks his life to escape and return to his family, he embarks on a perilous journey of love and endurance.

zh.summary: 这部托尼奖获奖音乐剧百老汇现场拍摄版，讲述了一个非凡的真实故事：2001年9月11日，38个航班在一个加拿大的小镇迫降。当地人接待了这些“远道而来的人”，他们聚在一起并找到了希望。
zh.summary_original: Filmed live on Broadway, the Tony Award-winning musical tells the remarkable true story of 38 flights grounded in a small Canadian town on September 11, 2001. As the locals host these “come from aways,” they come together and find hope.

zh.summary: 泰曾是一个郁郁不得志的玩具推销员，直到他与三名女性合作，将他的毛绒玩具变成了90年代的标志性潮流。这部幕后纪录片展现了历史上最大的玩具狂热，是一个关于这个世界如何对事物和人进行估价的疯狂故事。
zh.summary_original: Ty was a frustrated toy salesman until his collaboration with three women turned his stuffed animals into a defining ’90s trend. This behind-the-scenes look at history’s biggest toy craze is a wild story about what—and who—is valued in this world.

zh.summary: Scarlett Johansson 和 Channing Tatum 主演，分别饰演营销专家和循规蹈矩的发射主管，他们组队执行一项任务，背景设定在美国宇航局历史性的阿波罗 11 号登月这一高风险背景下。
zh.summary_original: Scarlett Johansson and Channing Tatum star as a marketing maven and a by-the-book launch director who team up for a mission set against the high-stakes backdrop of NASA’s historic Apollo 11 moon landing.

zh.summary: 荣获包括最佳男主角在内的3项奥斯卡®提名。丹泽尔·华盛顿与弗兰西丝·麦克多曼德主演了乔尔·科恩的大胆而激烈的改编作品——一个关于谋杀、疯狂、野心与愤怒狡诈的故事。
zh.summary_original: Nominated for 3 Oscars®, including Best Actor. Denzel Washington and Frances McDormand star in Joel Coen’s bold and fierce adaptation—a tale of murder, madness, ambition, and wrathful cunning.

zh.summary: 在航空业的黄金时代，一位年轻的飞机爱好者和他的母亲踏上了前往好莱坞的跨国之旅——他们简单的飞行演变成了一生难忘的旅程。约翰·特拉沃尔塔执导的电影。
zh.summary_original: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime. A film by John Travolta.

detailMetadata.summary: 好莱坞明星Reef Hawk（基努·里维斯 饰）被人以一个神秘视频进行勒索，形象和职业面临崩塌，他必须深入探索自己心中隐藏的恶魔。在多年好友Kyle（卡梅隆·迪亚兹 饰）、Xander（马特·波莫 饰）和应对危机的律师Ira（乔纳·希尔 饰）的帮助下，Reef展开了一场自我反省的旅程，要去补偿任何他可能辜负过的人，想搞清楚勒索者是谁。面临自己的过去，才能拯救自己的未来。
detailMetadata.title: 星途恶果

zh.summary: Reef Hawk自六岁起就是好莱坞的代言人，他的状态并不好。当得知一桩与神秘视频有关的勒索阴谋时，Reef先发制人地踏上了救赎之旅，以弥补过错、直面内心的恶魔，并避免遭到封杀。
zh.summary_original: Reef Hawk, Hollywood’s poster child since age six, is not okay. When he learns about an extortion plot tied to a mysterious video, Reef preemptively sets out on a redemption tour to make amends, confront his demons, and avoid getting canceled.

works.summaryEn: Roger Ferris (Leonardo DiCaprio) is the best man U.S. Intelligence has on the ground, in places where human life is worth no more than the information it can get you. In operations that take him around the globe, Ferris' next breath often depends on the voice at the other end of a secure phone line--CIA veteran Ed Hoffman (Russell Crowe). Strategizing from a laptop in the suburbs, Hoffman is on the trail of an emerging terrorist leader who has orchestrated a campaign of bombings while eluding the most sophisticated intelligence network in the world. To lure the terrorist out into the open, Ferris will have to penetrate his murky world, but the closer Ferris gets to the target, the more he discovers that trust is both a dangerous commodity and the only one that will get him out alive.

detailMetadata.summary: 罗格·菲利斯（莱昂那多·迪卡普里奥 Leonardo DiCaprio 饰）曾是一名穿梭于炮火硝烟中的战地记者，如今他受雇于CIA，成为美国方面潜伏在伊拉克的特工，随时追踪臭名昭著的恐怖分子阿尔萨里姆（Alon Aboutboul 饰）。他的上司爱德·霍夫曼（罗素·克劳 Russell Crowe 饰）在遥远的美国坐镇，他凭借手中的电脑掌控大局。 通过一个不愿当人肉炸弹的恐怖分子的供述，罗格得知阿尔萨里姆正在策划新一轮的恐怖袭击。在接下来的冲突中，罗格的助手不幸身亡，自己也多处负伤。就在他还未康复之际，又被霍夫曼派往了阿曼。另一方面，对手不断散播与美国军方达成合作的谣言，这令身处虎穴的罗格顿时陷入莫大的危险之中……
detailMetadata.title: 谎言之躯

zh.summary: 罗杰·费里斯（莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥 饰）是美国情报部门最顶尖的外勤人员，在那些人命连能换取的情报都不如的地方执行任务。在带他走遍全球的行动中，费里斯的下一次呼吸往往取决于安全电话线另一端的声音——中情局老兵埃德·霍夫曼（罗素·克劳 饰）。霍夫曼在郊区的笔记本电脑前运筹帷幄，正追踪着一个新崛起的恐怖分子头目，该头目在躲避世界上最先进的情报网络的同时，策划了一系列爆炸活动。为了引诱恐怖分子现身，费里斯将不得不深入其阴暗的世界，然而费里斯越接近目标，就越发现信任既是一种危险的筹码，也是唯一能让他活着离开的东西。

works.summaryEn: Cole (Bruce Willis) is sent back in time to save the human race from a deadly virus that has forced mankind into dank underground communities in the future. Along his travels, he encounters a psychiatrist (Madeleine Stowe) and a mental patient, brilliantly portrayed by Brad Pitt, who may hold the key to the mysterious rogue group, the Army of the 12 Monkeys, thought to be responsible for unleashing the killer disease. Believing he can obtain a pure virus sample in order to find a cure in the future, he is met with one riddle after another that puts him in a race with time. This sci-fi masterpiece from the genius mind of Terry Gilliam is a modern-day classic.

detailMetadata.summary: 公元2035年，人类被12只猴子军研制的一种病毒侵袭，大部分人类都在这场病毒灾难中死亡，只有少数人侥幸逃生，但也只能在阴暗的地下，苟且偷生。 科学家们决定派人穿越时光回到1996年追查12只猴子军的来历。囚徒詹姆斯·科尔(布鲁斯·威利斯 Bruce Willis 饰)被 挑选为志愿者。阴差阳错，科尔回到了1990年，当他向当时的人们描述未来的那场大灾难时，被当作精神病捉了起来并被医生凯瑟琳·雪莉（玛德琳·斯通 Madeleine Stowe 饰）诊断为精神分裂症。科尔在病友杰弗里·戈因斯帮助下逃脱，回到了未来。因为没查清12只猴子军的来历，科尔再次被派回了1996年。 科尔这次发现了12只猴子军的起源地在费城，他找到了医生凯瑟琳，二人一起展开了追查12只猴子军的冒险之旅!
detailMetadata.title: 十二猴子

zh.summary: 科尔（布鲁斯·威利斯 饰）被送回过去，以拯救人类免受致命病毒的侵害，该病毒迫使人类在未来居住在阴暗的地下社区中。在旅途中，他遇到了一位精神病学家（玛德琳·斯托）和一个精神病人（布拉德·皮特饰，其精湛的演技令人叹为观止），后者可能掌握着解开神秘反叛组织“十二猴子军”的关键，该组织被认为是释放这场致命疾病的元凶。他坚信自己能够获得纯净的病毒样本以便在未来找到治疗方法，但他却接连遇到一个个谜题，与时间展开了一场赛跑。这部由天才导演特瑞·吉利姆打造的科幻杰作是一部现代经典之作。
zh.summary_original: Cole (Bruce Willis) is sent back in time to save the human race from a deadly virus that has forced mankind into dank underground communities in the future. Along his travels, he encounters a psychiatrist (Madeleine Stowe) and a mental patient, brilliantly portrayed by Brad Pitt, who may hold the key to the mysterious rogue group, the Army of the 12 Monkeys, thought to be responsible for unleashing the killer disease. Believing he can obtain a pure virus sample in order to find a cure in the future, he is met with one riddle after another that puts him in a race with time. This sci-fi masterpiece from the genius mind of Terry Gilliam is a modern-day classic.
zh.title: 十二猴子

works.summaryEn: Linguistics professor Louise Banks (Amy Adams) leads an elite team of investigators when gigantic spaceships touch down in 12 locations around the world. As nations teeter on the verge of global war, Banks and her crew must race against time to find a way to communicate with the extraterrestrial visitors. Hoping to unravel the mystery, she takes a chance that could threaten her life and quite possibly all of mankind.

detailMetadata.summary: 地球的上空突然出现了十二架贝壳状的不明飞行物，悬浮在十二个不同的国家的上空，外星人向人类发出了讯号，但人类却并不能够解读。美国军方找到了语言学家路易斯（艾米·亚当斯 Amy Adams 饰）和物理学家伊恩（杰瑞米·雷纳 Jeremy Renner 饰），希望两人能够合作破解外星人的语言之谜。 经过数次的接触，路易斯发现外星人使用了一种极为特殊的圆环状的文字，并逐渐了解了其中的奥妙。由于一直无法确定外星人来到地球的真正目的，中国、俄罗斯等四国决定对外星人发起进攻，美方亦决定放弃研究将全部人员撤离，在这个节骨眼上，路易斯终于明白了外星人的意图，利用外星人赋予她的特殊的“武器”，路易斯以一人之力改变了未来。
detailMetadata.title: 降临

detailMetadata.summary: 随着科技的发展，人类发明了能侦察人的脑电波的“聪明”的机器人――“先知”。“先知”能侦察出人的犯罪企图，所以在罪犯犯罪之前，就已经被犯罪预防组织的警察逮捕并获刑。 乔恩（汤姆•克鲁斯 Tom Cruise 饰）就是犯罪预防组织的一个主管。在一次通过“先知”成功阻止了一起因外遇引起的双人命案之后，乔恩隐约感到了这一套完美的预防犯罪系统中隐含的秘密，那就是少数派报告。原来，共有三个“先知”一起判定一个人是否有杀人企图。当出现分歧时，按少数服从多数原则定案，但最后若证明少数那一方是正确的话，则会秘密保存一份少数派报告。 乔恩一觉醒来，突然发现自己已是昔日同事的抓捕对象。乔恩唯一的出路就是找到能证明自己清白的那份少数派报告……
detailMetadata.title: 少数派报告

zh.summary_original: Julianne Moore is Kate, whose secluded life is interrupted by her troubled daughter (Sydney Sweeney) when she shows up frightened and covered in someone's blood. As Kate unravels the shocking truth, she learns how far she’ll go for her child.

works.summaryEn: How far would you go to protect your family? Keller Dover (Hugh Jackman) is facing every parent's worst nightmare. His six-year-old daughter, Anna, is missing, together with her young friend, Joy, and as minutes turn to hours, panic sets in. The best lead is a dilapidated RV that had earlier been parked on their street. Heading the investigation, Detective Loki (Jake Gyllenhaal) arrests its driver, Alex Jones (Paul Dano), but a lack of evidence forces his release.

detailMetadata.summary: 凯勒（休·杰克曼 Hugh Jackman 饰）是一名木匠，一次意外中，他的女儿安娜（艾琳·格拉西莫维奇 Erin Gerasimovich 饰）同小伙伴乔伊（凯拉·德鲁·西蒙斯 Kyla Drew Simmons 饰）一起莫名失踪。对于女儿遭遇的不测，心急如焚的凯勒向警方寻求帮助，很快，案件的负责人洛基（杰克·吉伦哈尔 Jake Gyllenhaal 饰）就将目标锁定在了一位名叫艾利克斯（保罗·达诺 Paul Dano 饰）的男子身上。 不幸的是，由于证据不足，警方不得不在四十八小时之后释放了艾利克斯，对警方失望透顶的凯勒决定靠自己的力量寻找女儿的踪迹。经验丰富的凯勒亲手捉住了艾利克斯，他希望能够通过武力获取关于女儿的讯息。安娜和乔伊最终能够获救吗？坚称自己无辜的艾利克斯又是否真的就是罪魁祸首呢？

works.summaryEn: From director Christopher Nolan (Inception, The Dark Knight trilogy) comes the story of a team of pioneers undertaking the most important mission in human history. Academy Award®-winner Matthew McConaughey (Dallas Buyer’s Club) stars as ex-pilot-turned-farmer Cooper, who must leave his family and a foundering Earth behind to lead an expedition traveling beyond this galaxy to discover whether mankind has a future among the stars. Academy Award®-winner Anne Hathaway (Les Misérables) and Academy Award®-nominee Jessica Chastain (Zero Dark Thirty) also star in this landmark film.

detailMetadata.summary: 近未来的地球黄沙遍野，小麦、秋葵等基础农作物相继因枯萎病灭绝，人类不再像从前那样仰望星空，放纵想象力和灵感的迸发，而是每日在沙尘暴的肆虐下倒数着所剩不多的光景。在家务农的前NASA宇航员库珀（马修·麦康纳 Matthew McConaughey 饰）接连在女儿墨菲（麦肯吉·弗依 Mackenzie Foy 饰）的书房发现奇怪的重力场现象，随即得知在某个未知区域内前NASA成员仍秘密进行一个拯救人类的计划。多年以前土星附近出现神秘虫洞，NASA借机将数名宇航员派遣到遥远的星系寻找适合居住的星球。在布兰德教授（迈克尔·凯恩 Michael Caine 饰）的劝说下，库珀忍痛告别了女儿，和其他三名专家教授女儿艾米莉亚·布兰德（安妮·海瑟薇 Anne Hathaway 饰）、罗米利（大卫·吉雅西 David Gyasi 饰）、多伊尔（韦斯·本特利 Wes Bentley 饰）搭乘宇宙飞船前往目前已知的最有希望的三颗星球考察。 他们穿越遥远的星系银河，感受了一小时七年光阴的沧海桑田，窥见了未知星球和黑洞的壮伟与神秘。在浩瀚宇宙的绝望而孤独角落，总有一份超越了时空的笃定情怀将他们紧紧相连……

zh.summary: 导演克里斯托弗·诺兰（《盗梦空间》、《黑暗骑士》三部曲）带来了一群先驱者执行人类历史上最重要任务的故事。奥斯卡奖得主马修·麦康纳（《达拉斯买家俱乐部》）饰演由前飞行员转行的农民库珀，他必须离开家人和日渐衰落的地球，领导一支超越本星系的远征队，去探索人类在星际间是否有未来。奥斯卡奖得主安妮·海瑟薇（《悲惨世界》）和奥斯卡奖提名者杰西卡·查斯坦（《刺杀本·拉登》）也出演了这部里程碑式的电影。
zh.summary_original: From director Christopher Nolan (Inception, The Dark Knight trilogy) comes the story of a team of pioneers undertaking the most important mission in human history. Academy Award®-winner Matthew McConaughey (Dallas Buyer’s Club) stars as ex-pilot-turned-farmer Cooper, who must leave his family and a foundering Earth behind to lead an expedition traveling beyond this galaxy to discover whether mankind has a future among the stars. Academy Award®-winner Anne Hathaway (Les Misérables) and Academy Award®-nominee Jessica Chastain (Zero Dark Thirty) also star in this landmark film.

works.summaryEn: Forget the underlying plot in Get Smart, the modern-day cinematic adaptation of the classic TV series. What passes for one -- something about evil organization KAOS' attempts to bomb Los Angeles, with a preamble about weapons theft in Russia -- is rudimentary at best and confounding at worst. The movie is really the triumph-of-the-underdog story of Maxwell Smart (Steve Carell), a brilliant-but-nerdy analyst at secret government agency Control who finally gets his wish to become a field agent when headquarters is attacked and the identity of all of Control's operatives -- except for Agent 99 (Anne Hathaway) -- is compromised. It's up to Max and 99 to stop the bad guys and save the day ... provided they can learn to work together.

detailMetadata.summary: 冷战结束后，天控局面临被解散的危险，但是这个美国最大的特务机关，依旧担负着重要的使命。不过，近期天控局总部却遭受了突发性袭击，导致特工们都有被身份曝光的危险。其中也包括强壮如牛、身手不凡的23号特工（道恩•强森 Dwayne Johnson 饰）。总部经过研究发现，袭击事件是一个叫盖不达集团的，为了迎敌，总部对分析家麦克斯韦（史蒂夫•卡瑞尔 Steve Carell 饰）委以重任，后者终于等到了一展身手的机会。于是，他积极参与了对付盖不达的行动，不过之前的两次演习都被他搞砸了。唯一的收获是，他跟99号特工（安妮•海瑟薇 Anne Hathaway 饰）结成了搭档，后者是唯一不怕身份曝光的特工。他们在飞机上遇到了一个疑似的恐怖分子，但是当他们出手时，却意外陷入了对方的圈套。此后，这对欢喜冤家又接连遇到一系列令人啼笑皆非的困境……

zh.summary: 忘掉《糊涂侦探》（这部经典电视剧的现代电影改编版）背后的基本剧情吧。那些所谓的剧情——比如邪恶组织KAOS企图炸毁洛杉矶，以及关于俄罗斯武器盗窃案的开场白——往好了说是最基本的，往坏了说是令人费解的。这部电影实际上是一个关于草根逆袭的故事：麦克斯韦·斯马特（史蒂夫·卡瑞尔 饰）是秘密政府机构“管制局”里一个聪明但书呆子气的分析师，当总部遭到袭击，除了99号特工（安妮·海瑟薇 饰）之外所有管制局特工的身份都泄露时，他终于如愿以偿成为了一名外勤特工。麦克斯和99号必须阻止坏人并拯救世界……前提是他们能学会如何合作。

works.summaryEn: The fastest man on four wheels, Ricky Bobby (Will Ferrell) is one of the greatest drivers in NASCAR history. A big, hairy American winning machine, Ricky has everything a dimwitted daredevil could want, a luxurious mansion, a smokin' hot wife (Leslie Bibb) and all the fast food he can eat. But Ricky's turbo-charged lifestyle hits an unexpected speed bump when he's bested by flamboyant Euro-idiot Jean Girard (Sacha Baron Cohen, TV's "Da Ali G Show") and reduced to a fear-ridden wreck. Losing his wife and job to best bud and fellow fool, Cal Naughton, Jr. (John C. Reilly), Ricky must kick some serious asphalt if he's to get his career back on the track, beat Girard and reclaim his fame and fortune. 'Cause as Ricky Bobby always says, if you ain't first, you're last!

works.summaryEn: In Dave, Kevin Kline stars in dual roles as President Bill Mitchell and a temp agency owner named Dave Kovic. When the President has a massive stroke that leaves him in a vegetative state, his Chief of Staff, Bob Alexander (Frank Langella), convinces Dave to play the part. Whereas President Bill Mitchell was corrupt and nasty with a well-crafted political façade, Dave genuinely cares and wants to help people. This leads him to lock horns with Alexander, whose real agenda is to implicate the Vice President in a scandal and have "President Dave" nominate him the new VP just before pretending to have a second, fatal stroke. Ellen Mitchell (Sigourney Weaver) is the estranged First Lady who enjoys using her role to be of service to the needy, despite the lack of love in her marriage. She eventually catches on to the ruse and with her help, Dave is able to set things right and the two of them find romance along the way.

zh.summary: 在《冒牌总统》中，凯文·克莱恩一人分饰两角，分别饰演总统比尔·米歇尔和临时工中介老板戴夫·科维奇。当总统突发严重中风并陷入植物人状态时，他的幕僚长鲍勃·亚历山大（弗兰克·兰格拉饰）说服戴夫来扮演总统。比尔·米歇尔总统腐败而令人讨厌，有着精心伪装的政治外表，而戴夫则真心关爱他人并想要帮助人们。这导致他与亚历山大针锋相对，亚历山大的真正企图是将副总统卷入丑闻，并让“戴夫总统”在假装第二次致命中风之前提名他为新任副总统。埃伦·米歇尔（西格妮·韦弗饰）是一位疏远的真正第一夫人，尽管婚姻缺乏爱，她仍乐于利用自己的角色为需要帮助的人服务。她最终识破了这个骗局，并在她的帮助下，戴夫得以拨乱反正，两人也在过程中擦出了爱情的火花。

works.summaryEn: 'A lyrical, gorgeous and tough evocation of the unsteady fires of youth' ('Variety'). Robin Williams shines in this stirring 1989 drama as an English teacher who goes to work at his alma mater--a rigorous Vermont prep school--and lights a powerful flame in his students.

detailMetadata.summary: 威尔顿预备学院以其沉稳凝重的教学风格和较高的升学率闻名，作为其毕业班的学生，理想就是升入名校。新学期文学老师约翰·基汀（罗宾·威廉姆斯 饰）的到来如同一阵春风，一反传统名校的严肃刻板。 基汀带学生们在校史楼内聆听死亡的声音，反思生的意义 ；让男生们在绿茵场上宣读自己的理想；鼓励学生站在课桌上，用新的视角俯瞰世界。老师自由发散式的哲学思维让学生内心产生强烈的共鸣，他们渐渐学会自己思考与求索，勇敢的追问人生的路途，甚至违反门禁，成立死亡诗社，在山洞里击节而歌！ 基汀教授、基汀老师、基汀队长，他的教育宛若春风化雨，润物无声的留在每个人心里…

works.summaryEn: Captain “Lucky” Jack Aubrey (Russell Crowe) is a renowned fighting captain in the British Navy. But when his ship, the Surprise, is suddenly attacked by a superior enemy, Aubrey is torn between duty and friendship as he pursues a high-stakes chase across two oceans to intercept and capture his foe. With a badly damaged ship and an injured crew, this mission can save his reputation, or destroy them all. Nominated for 10 Academy Awards, including Best Picture!

works.summaryEn: Vincent Vega (John Travolta) and Jules Winnfield (Samuel L. Jackson) are hitmen with a penchant for philosophical discussions. In this ultra-hip, multi-strand crime movie, their storyline is interwoven with those of their boss, gangster Marsellus Wallace (Ving Rhames) ; his actress wife, Mia (Uma Thurman) ; struggling boxer Butch Coolidge (Bruce Willis) ; master fixer Winston Wolfe (Harvey Keitel) and a nervous pair of armed robbers, "Pumpkin" (Tim Roth) and "Honey Bunny" (Amanda Plummer).

detailMetadata.summary: 《低俗小说》由“文森特和马沙的妻子”、“金表”、“邦妮的处境”三个故事以及影片首尾的序幕和尾声五个部分组成。看似独立的小故事里面，却又有环环相扣的人和事。 盗贼“小南瓜”和“小兔子”在早餐店里打劫，却遇上了天大的麻烦——黑社会成员朱尔斯（塞缪尔•杰克逊Samuel L. Jackson饰）和文森特（约翰•特拉沃尔塔John Travolta饰）在店内用餐，可谓天外有天。二人是否会放过两名小盗贼？ 而文森特是黑社会大哥马沙•华莱士（文•瑞姆斯Ving Rhames饰）的手下，马沙下命令让他陪妻子一个晚上，明知如有雷池必死无疑，但面对马沙妻子美艳诱惑，文森特该怎么办。 文森特的故事还没完，拳击手布奇（布鲁斯•威利斯Bruce Willis饰）的出现将令他的人生从此改变。布奇有一块祖传金表，就是因为这块金表，他和马沙分享了一个耻辱的秘密。 故事环状结构，回到开端。朱尔斯在小盗贼面前诵读圣经，表示对杀人的厌倦和感悟。什么事件令他如此转变？“邦妮的处境”中就有答案。

works.summaryEn: A culinary legend provides a frustrated office worker with a new recipe for life in Julie & Julia, the true stories of how Julia Child's (Meryl Streep) life and cookbook inspired fledgling writer Julie Powell (Amy Adams) to whip up 524 recipes in 365 days and introduce a new generation to the magic of French cooking. Stanley Tucci (The Devil Wears Prada) co-stars in director Nora Ephron's delicious comedy about joy, obsession and butter. Bon appétit!

detailMetadata.summary: 在康复中心戒毒治疗的金茉（安妮•海瑟薇 Anne Hathaway饰），因为姐姐蕾切尔（罗丝玛丽•德薇特 Rosemarie DeWitt 饰）即将举行婚礼，被父亲保罗（比尔•欧文 Bill Irwin 饰）接回了家。但她还是要定期去参加瘾君子互助会活动。巧的是，她发现姐夫的伴郎基兰（玛德•奇科尔 Mather Zickel 饰）竟然也是互助会成员，同命相怜的两人倍感亲近。 在交流中，金茉得知伴娘不是自己，勃然大怒。经过一番争取，蕾切尔最终还是同意金茉出任伴娘。但是，这次妥协并没未让姐妹重修旧好。金茉不合时宜的“道歉计划”让整个家庭陷入了矛盾之中，只有父亲始终细心维护着她。在一次争吵中，姐姐蕾切尔提及早年弟弟车祸死亡之事，这让金茉内心的负罪感愈加沉重，并导致她与母亲艾比（德博拉•温格 Debra Winger 饰）大打出手……

detailMetadata.summary: 在电视播音员被视为权威的昔日年代里，朗•伯甘蒂（威尔•法瑞尔 Will Ferrell 饰）是屡屡获奖的圣迭戈王牌播音员，4频道在他的新闻小组的带领下笑傲同行，组内的三个怪家伙只有在朗的身边才能大展拳脚。工作之外，风流成性的朗自然也不会放弃利用知名度勾女，然而一个让他吃瘪的女郎维罗妮卡（克里斯蒂娜•艾伯盖特 Christina Applegate 饰）居然还是新闻部的新同事，众人先后对维罗妮卡展开攻势结果全军覆没，最后朗用狂野的风度征服了冰美人，维罗妮卡与朗的期望不同，这个有强烈事业心的女人开始在工作中崭露头角并挑战朗的地位，一次车祸后，朗的生活迅速变得混乱起来…… 影片申明“本片根据真实故事改编”。

works.summaryEn: "Stupid is as stupid does," says Forrest Gump (played by Tom Hanks in an Oscar-winning performance) as he discusses his relative level of intelligence with a stranger while waiting for a bus. Despite his sub-normal IQ, Gump leads a truly charmed life, with a ringside seat for many of the most memorable events of the second half of the 20th century. Featured alongside Tom Hanks are Sally Field as Forrest's mother; Gary Sinise as his commanding officer in Vietnam; Mykelti Williamson as his ill-fated Army buddy who is familiar with every recipe that involves shrimp; and the special effects artists whose digital magic place Forrest amidst a remarkable array of historical events and people.

works.summaryEn: Liz Gilbert (Julia Roberts) is a modern woman on a quest to marvel at and travel the world while rediscovering and reconnecting with her true inner self in Eat Pray Love. At a crossroads after a divorce, Gilbert takes a year-long sabbatical from her job and steps uncharacteristically out of her comfort zone, risking everything to change her life. In her wondrous and exotic travels, she experiences the simple pleasure of nourishment by eating in Italy; the power of prayer in India, and, finally and unexpectedly, the inner peace and balance of love in Bali. Based on an inspiring true story, Eat Pray Love proves that there really is more than one way to let yourself go and see the world.

works.summaryEn: From director Michael Bay (The Rock, Armageddon) and the production team of Don Simpson and Jerry Bruckheimer (Beverly Hills Cop, Top Gun) comes a thrill ride of explosive action from beginning to end. Will Smith and Martin Lawrence team up as partners in crime, crime-fighting that is, in this action-packed flick about a couple of good guys who are real Bad Boys! One hundred million dollars worth of confiscated heroin has just been jacked from police custody. Once the career bust of Detective Mike Lowery (Will Smith) and Marcus Burnett (Martin Lawrence), the missing drugs now threaten to shut down the narcotics division of the Miami Police Department. When the drug investigation turns deadly, the murderers kidnap the only witness, a beautful police informant (Téa Leoni) and close friend of the boys, which makes things get personal! Fast cars, a gorgeous woman and non-stop action make Bad Boys a guaranteed good time!

works.summaryEn: After a wish turns 12-year-old Josh Baskin (David Moscow) into a 30-year-old man (Tom Hanks), he heads to New York City and gets a low-level job at MacMillen Toy Company. A chance encounter with the owner (Robert Loggia) of the company leads to a promotion testing new toys. Soon a fellow employee, Susan Lawrence (Elizabeth Perkins), takes a romantic interest in Josh. works.summaryEn: Jane Austen might never have imagined that her 1816 novel Emma could be turned into a fresh and satirical look at ultra-rich teenagers in a Beverly Hills high school. Cher (Alicia Silverstone) and Dionne (Stacey Dash), both named after "great singers of the past that now do infomercials," are pampered upper-class girls who care less about getting good grades than wearing the right clothes and being as popular as possible. But Cher, who lives with her tough yet warm-hearted lawyer dad (Dan Hedaya) and hunky, sensitive stepbrother (Paul Rudd), also has an innate urge to help those less fortunate — like the two introverted teachers she brings together ("negotiating" herself improved grades in the process) and new friend Tai (Brittany Murphy), who starts out a geek and ends up a Cher prodigy. Cher also possesses her own sensitive side, and she is looking for the perfect boyfriend, whom she ends up finding where she least expected.

detailMetadata.summary: 故事发生在位于比弗利山庄的一所贵族学校中，能够进入此学校就读的学生们，非富即贵，所以，校园里奢侈和自由的风气和普通的学校是无法相比的。在这里，成绩和品行都不重要，重要的是五颜六色的名牌时装，是闪闪发光的珠宝配饰，是张扬奔放肆意挥洒的个性。我们的主人公雪儿（艾丽西亚·希尔维斯通 Alicia Silverstone 饰）就在这样的世界里生活成长着。 一位转学生的到来吸引了雪儿的注意，在偌大的校园里，在同学朋友的眼中，这名转学生简直就是“怪胎”，穿着平庸打扮又土气，雪儿决定帮助她改头换面，“重新做人”。在雪儿的指导下，转学生果然有了焕然一新的面貌，甚至更胜雪儿一筹，这让雪儿的内心里十分不平。

zh.summary_original: Fresh out of college and stuck at his New Jersey home without a clear path forward, 22-year-old Andrew begins working as a party starter for bar/bat mitzvahs—where he strikes up a unique friendship with a young mom and her teenage daughter.

zh.summary: 单亲妈妈芙罗拉对于如何管教叛逆的青少年儿子马克斯感到束手无策。她为了让他远离麻烦，送上了一把破旧的木吉他、找来了一位落魄的洛杉矶音乐人，并为这个破碎的都柏林家庭带来了和谐。
zh.summary_original: Single mom Flora is at a loss about what to do with her rebellious teenage son, Max. Her efforts to keep him out of trouble lead to a beat-up acoustic guitar, a washed-up LA musician, and harmony for this frayed Dublin family.

zh.summary: 在姐姐失踪后，杰克斯（莉莉·格莱斯顿饰）和她的侄女罗基必须相依为命。为了拼死保全破碎的家，杰克斯和罗基无视法律，踏上了前往俄克拉荷马城参加“大国”传统欢庆会的旅程。
zh.summary_original: Following her sister’s disappearance, Jax (Lily Gladstone) and her niece Roki must stick together. Desperate to keep what’s left of their family intact, Jax and Roki defy the law and hit the road on a journey to the Grand Nation Powwow in Oklahoma City.

zh.summary: 莱妮是一名正为姐姐离世而悲痛的少年音乐神童，她发现自己夹在学校里新来的男生和姐姐悲痛欲绝的男友之间。凭借生动的想象力和矛盾的内心，莱妮度过了初恋和初次失去的时光。
zh.summary_original: Lennie is a teen musical prodigy grieving the death of her sister when she finds herself caught between a new guy at school and her sister's devastated boyfriend. Through her vivid imagination and conflicted heart, Lennie navigates first love and first loss.

zh.summary: 想象一下查尔斯·狄更斯那个温馨感人的故事：一个吝啬鬼在平安夜遭到四个幽灵的造访——但更有趣。还有威尔·法瑞尔、瑞安·雷诺兹和奥克塔维亚·斯宾瑟。此外，还有盛大的歌舞表演。好吧，我们的要求有点多。也许看下预告片就行？
zh.summary_original: Imagine Charles Dickens’ heartwarming tale of a scrooge visited by four ghosts on Christmas Eve—but funnier. And with Will Ferrell, Ryan Reynolds, and Octavia Spencer. Also, huge musical numbers. Okay, we’re asking a lot. Maybe just watch the trailer?

zh.summary: 与荣获艾美奖®的明星汉娜·沃丁厄姆一起欢度节日，她将在伦敦大剧院迎接特邀嘉宾，呈现一场精彩绝伦的音乐盛宴。
zh.summary_original: Ring in the holidays with Emmy®-winning star Hannah Waddingham as she welcomes special guests for a musical extravaganza at the London Coliseum.

works.summaryEn: James Corden passes the keys to Zane Lowe for this international holiday road trip. It’s a pop diva winter wonderland when Zane gets festive with Dua Lipa in Japan, Chappell Roan in her Missouri hometown, and Lady Gaga in Los Angeles.

zh.summary: 詹姆斯·柯登将钥匙交给了赞恩·洛，开启这场国际节日公路旅行。当赞恩在日本与杜阿·利帕、在密苏里州家乡与查普尔·罗恩、在洛杉矶与Lady Gaga共度佳节时，这里便成了流行天后的冬日仙境。
zh.summary_original: James Corden passes the keys to Zane Lowe for this international holiday road trip. It’s a pop diva winter wonderland when Zane gets festive with Dua Lipa in Japan, Chappell Roan in her Missouri hometown, and Lady Gaga in Los Angeles.

zh.summary: 同父异母的兄弟雷蒙德和雷在疏远的父亲去世后重聚，并发现他最后的愿望是让他们为他挖墓。他们共同审视了自己作为男人的成长，既因父亲而起，也与父亲无关。
zh.summary_original: Half brothers Raymond and Ray reunite when their estranged father dies—and discover that his final wish was for them to dig his grave. Together, they process who they’ve become as men, both because of their father and in spite of him.

works.summaryEn: Witness the media craze that followed Messi's transformative move to Inter Miami CF and the ripple effect it sent through the world of soccer.

zh.summary: 见证梅西转会至国际迈阿密后引发的轰动全球的媒体狂潮，以及它在足球世界中掀起的波澜。

zh.summary_original: Relive San Diego's epic announcement as Major League Soccer welcomes its thirtieth club.

zh.summary: 面对节日欢乐危机，北极深知只有一个人能够力挽狂澜：圣诞老人的好朋友玛丽亚·凯莉。这位圣诞女王打造了一场精彩绝伦、群星璀璨的盛会，让全世界都沉浸在欢乐之中！
zh.summary_original: Faced with a holiday cheer crisis, the North Pole knows there's only one person who can save the day: Santa's great friend Mariah Carey. The Queen of Christmas creates a fabulous and star-studded spectacular to make the whole world merry!

zh.summary: 圣诞女王携满满的节日欢乐回归这部特辑。玛丽亚与哈利德和柯克·富兰克林一同表演了她迷人的原创歌曲《Fall in Love at Christmas》，与 Apple Music 的赞恩·洛进行了交谈，并以一首节日经典曲目结束。
zh.summary_original: The Queen of Christmas returns with a blast of holiday cheer in this special. Mariah performs her enchanting original song “Fall in Love at Christmas” with Khalid and Kirk Franklin, chats with Apple Music’s Zane Lowe, and signs off with a festive classic.
